Entries.Title: The First Frost
Entries.Description: Down-on-her-luck news reporter Wen Yifan visits a newly opened restaurant, but soon realizes that it's owned by Sang Yan, her childhood crush.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Sang Yan. Goodbye, Wen Yi Fan.
Episodes.Description: Down-on-her-luck news reporter Wen Yifan visits a newly opened restaurant, but soon realizes that it's owned by Sang Yan, her childhood crush.

Episodes.Title: Your Name Is Written on My Heart.
Episodes.Description: After narrowly escaping an assault by her violent roommate, Wen Yifan and Sang Yan cross paths again as she decides to change her living arrangements.

Episodes.Title: Everyone Needs a Romantic Interest. You're My Romantic Interest.
Episodes.Description: Fate pushes Wen Yifan and Sang Yan together once more when her moving plans fall through and a fire breaks out at his apartment complex.

Episodes.Title: Rumors. I'll Dispel the Rumors for You.
Episodes.Description: Wen Yifan has a tense encounter with her sister, and Sang Yan officially moves in. Some old friends stop by for a night of nostalgia.

Episodes.Title: Get Closer, Would You?
Episodes.Description: A game of Truth or Dare leads to a surprising kiss. Sang Yan stews over his regrets. Wen Yifan's mother asks her to visit for New Year's Eve.

Episodes.Title: I Will Always Be with You. Will You Always Be with Me?
Episodes.Description: Working through New Year's celebrations, a lonely Wen Yifan struggles to cope. As Sang Yan steps in to keep her company, she reflects on her childhood.

Episodes.Title: A Secret… that Can’t Be Kept
Episodes.Description: Sang Yan's sister visits and reminisces about the past. After Wen Yifan has a difficult conversation with her aunt, Sang Yan tries to cheer her up.

Episodes.Title: The Sun In the Rain, Dazzling and Warm
Episodes.Description: A sleepwalking incident has Sang Yan questioning the nature of his relationship with Wen Yifan, who downplays its significance.

Episodes.Title: False of Heart, Honest of Action
Episodes.Description: Wen Yifan encounters a stalker, but a mysterious stranger with an odd connection to her childhood comes to her rescue. Sang Yan secures a job interview.

Episodes.Title: You Forgot, but I Still Remember
Episodes.Description: Wen Yifan opens up to her old friend Zhong Siqiao about her personal problems, and another sleepwalking incident raises the stakes for her and Sang Yan.

Episodes.Title: Take Care of Yourself. I’m Always Here.
Episodes.Description: Sang Yan helps Wen Yifan come to terms with the trauma behind her sleepwalking. Later, she begins an unusual assignment with Mu Chengyun.

Episodes.Title: How to Be Happy? Staying with You
Episodes.Description: At a party, a tipsy Wen Yifan asks Sang Yan about their graduation ceremony. Mu Chengyun's pursuit sparks jealousy.

Episodes.Title: We Made a Promise: I Want to Be with You
Episodes.Description: Su Hao'an's secret is exposed. A guilt-ridden Wen Yifan sleepwalks again.

Episodes.Title: Can’t Let Go of My Feelings for You
Episodes.Description: Panic erupts when Grandpa Su goes missing. When a drunk Sang Yan bares his heart, Wen Yifan is left both moved and unsettled.

Episodes.Title: Marks Left by Love
Episodes.Description: Zhong Siqiao and Sang Yan learn of Grandpa Su's illness. With tensions rising and much left unsaid, Wen Yifan considers moving out.

Episodes.Title: Happy Birthday. Contented.
Episodes.Description: After Sang Yan organizes her birthday celebration, Wen Yifan makes a decision and confesses to her friend Zhong Siqiao.

Episodes.Title: The Farthest Distance Is an Unspoken “I Love You”
Episodes.Description: As their relationship heats up, Sang Yan and Wen Yifan enjoy a dinner date, but the mood sours when her troublemaking sister appears.

Episodes.Title: On My Way to You
Episodes.Description: Rushed away to report on a landslide, Wen Yi Fan realizes that she may have to break a promise to Sang Yan. Later, she makes a confession.

Episodes.Title: Bai Jiang Doesn’t Mean I’m a Loser But That I Only Lost to You, Wen Shuang Jiang
Episodes.Description: After Wen Yi Fan and Sang Yan announce their relationship, Su Hao'an wrestles with his feelings for Zhong Si Qiao. Xiang Lang ruins a sensitive moment.

Episodes.Title: To Catch You Every Time You Feel Vulnerable
Episodes.Description: A phone call interrupts a romantic evening between Wen Yi Fan and Sang Yan. Zhong Si Qiao searches for Su Hao An, and Wen Yi Fan receives bad news.

Episodes.Title: Where Is Hope? Hope Is Everywhere with You in the Future
Episodes.Description: Reporting on a car crash proves a shocking experience for Wen Yi Fan, who seeks comfort from Sang Yan. Zhong Si Qiao agrees to give Su Hao An a chance.

Episodes.Title: Opportunity Is for You
Episodes.Description: At a wedding, Mu Cheng Yun apologizes to Wen Yi Fan for his behavior and offers her and Sang Yan his blessing. An unwelcome presence lurks nearby.

Episodes.Title: Where to Hide?
Episodes.Description: Through moments of poignant vulnerability and introspective reflection, Wen Yi Fan confronts past errors and the internal conflicts that impede her emotional progress.

Episodes.Title: The Reason I Left
Episodes.Description: Feeling guilty for disrupting Sang Yan's life, Wen Yifan leaves town for Hong Kong. Sang Yan and his friends join forces to search for her there.

Episodes.Title: No Matter Where You Are, I'll Find You
Episodes.Description: Trying to track down Wen Yifan, Sang Yan uncovers her connection to Che Xingde, who has tormented her since high school.

Episodes.Title: This Time, I Won't Break the Promise
Episodes.Description: Sang Yan confronts Che Xingde when he harasses women at the restaurant. Then, he heads to Hong Kong to find Wen Yifan, who now works at a dance studio.

Episodes.Title: I Accept My Imperfections
Episodes.Description: An old injury hinders Wen Yifan's preparation for a dance contest. If Zhong Siqiao and Su Hao'an ever locate her, will she come home?

Episodes.Title: I Want a Second Chance, If There's One
Episodes.Description: Wen Yifan reports on a disturbing crime for which Che Xingde is the prime suspect. Then, she rushes to be with a distressed Sang Yan.

Episodes.Title: Love Means Being Each Other's Light
Episodes.Description: Overcome with worry, Wen Yifan helps Sang Yan to recover. The authorities make an arrest, and Wen Yifan's sister pays her a visit.

Episodes.Title: Relying: Trusting You in Weakness, Chosen by You Firmly
Episodes.Description: As Sang Yan continues to heal, Wen Yifan receives a surprise visitor at work. Su Hao'an's family finds closure.

Episodes.Title: Loving You, From the First Day to Forever
Episodes.Description: As the Spring Festival approaches, Wen Yifan prepares a special dance for Sang Yan, who invites her to visit his family to celebrate the new year.

Episodes.Title: I Long for Someone to Love Me Fiercely Until Death. It's You.
Episodes.Description: Moving out of the apartment, Wen Yifan finds a touching memento hidden away. Sang Yan makes bold plans to ask her a life-changing question.

Entries.Title: Kill to Love
Entries.Description: A palace assassination attempt forces Xiao Shu He to aid a wounded stranger tied to his past.

Episodes.Title: Fated Reunion
Episodes.Description: A palace assassination attempt forces Xiao Shu He to aid a wounded stranger tied to his past.

Episodes.Title: Suspicion
Episodes.Description: Memories resurface as Duan seeks his brother, but Huo Ying’s report casts doubt on his identity.

Episodes.Title: A Gift from Heaven
Episodes.Description: At the banquet, Xiao Shu He’s gift stirs old wounds, while Duan and Gu hint at hidden intrigues.

Episodes.Title: Entering Court Politics
Episodes.Description: Donning mountain river brocade, Xiao Shu He steps into court politics amid rising tensions.

Episodes.Title: Political Marriage
Episodes.Description: Ordered to marry a princess, Xiao Shu He hides Duan Zi Ang, fueling unrest and secret schemes.

Episodes.Title: Search the Residence
Episodes.Description: Duan Zi Ang steps up to shield Xiao Shu He, sparking the Crown Prince’s plot to raid his home.

Episodes.Title: Brothers Reunited
Episodes.Description: Duan Zi Ang finds his lost brother, while Xiao Shu He dreams of freedom and a future together.

Episodes.Title: Mutiny
Episodes.Description: The Crown Prince revolts, besieging Xiao Shu He’s home. Duan urges escape, but Shu He stands firm.

Episodes.Title: Becoming Enemies
Episodes.Description: Now emperor, Xiao Shu He rejects Duan Zi Ang’s letters, severing their bond to protect his rule.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Give You Sunny Day, But I Only Have An Umbrella Woven from Storm Clouds
The Spring is Bright, But Gone Forever

Entries.Title: The Immortal Ascension
Entries.Description: The young Han Li and his childhood friend, Zhang Tie, were taken on as students by the divine healer, Physician Mo. He imparts an incantation to them. He says that those who master the incantation will become immortals.

Episodes.Title: Herb-Gathering Boy
Episodes.Description: The young Han Li and his childhood friend, Zhang Tie, were taken on as students by the divine healer, Physician Mo. He imparts an incantation to them. He says that those who master the incantation will become immortals.

Episodes.Title: Zhang Tie's Peril
Episodes.Description:
Zhang Tie overhears the secret conversation between Master Mo and Yu Zi Tong. He attempts to warn Han Li, only to expose himself. Master Mo takes

ruthless measures against him.

Episodes.Title: Takeover
Episodes.Description: Han Li reaches level six of the Art of Changchun. However, he still falls into the trap of Physician Mo. Physician Mo's consciousness fights against Han Li's consciousness in his mind. Han Li finds out that Physician Mo is trying to take over his body.

Episodes.Title: A Night Visit to the Mo Family
Episodes.Description: To neutralize the poison, Han Li delivered Physician Mo's handwritten letter to the Mo family. He didn't expect Physician Mo to hide a message within the letter. To keep the Mo family safe, the madams of the Mo family decide to take advantage of Han Li.

Episodes.Title: Green Vein Society
Episodes.Description:
Han Li arrives at Tainan Valley. He encounters Taoist Qing Wen, the leader of Green Vein Society. Nangong Wan, an elder of Moon Concealing Sect, is

investigating the random murder of rogue cultivators. She sets her sights on the suspicious Green Vein Society.

Episodes.Title: Ascension Trials
Episodes.Description: The Ascension Trials commence. Due to his quadruple-attribute spiritual root, Han Li is rejected by all the sects and ultimately fails the selection process.

Episodes.Title: Farewell to His Family
Episodes.Description: Han Li makes up his mind to pursue the path of cultivation. He goes home before departing to Huangfeng Valley to bid his family farewell.

Episodes.Title: The Foundation Pill
Episodes.Description: Lu Ming Yuan tries to get intimate with Chen Qiao Qian, but as she rejects him, he takes it out on Han Li, who happens to pass by. Lu Ming Yuan demands Han Li to hand over the Foundation Pill.

Episodes.Title: The Crimson Forbidden Ground
Episodes.Description: To break through his current level, Han Li decides to enter the Crimson Forbidden Ground to find the ingredients of the Foundation Pill.

Episodes.Title: Entering the Forbidden Ground
Episodes.Description: To cure Yan Ru Yan of her ailment, Nangong Wan decides to suppress her power and head to the forbidden ground personally to harvest the required herbs.

Episodes.Title: Seeking Out the Fiery Sun Blossom
Episodes.Description: Right before entering the center area of the forbidden ground, Han Li encounters Han Yun Shi. She hangs in there to seek out the Fiery Sun Blossom for her brother. Han Li finds out that there are impostors of the Seven Sects' members. He can't bear to leave her alone. He decides to take her with him in search of the Fiery Sun Blossom.

Episodes.Title: Making a Name
Episodes.Description: After slaying the Inky Flood Dragon together, Han Li and Nangong Wan race against time as the exit from the Crimson Forbidden Ground begins to close. Han Li acts quickly to get Nangong Wan out.

Episodes.Title: Foundation Stage
Episodes.Description:
Han Li creates 14 Foundation Pills with the herbs he found in the Crimson Forbidden Ground. He decides to use them as the foundation of his cultivation. He prepares for his seclusion in the Alchemy Chamber. He goes into an 11-month seclusion. He finally reaches the Foundation

Stage together with Chen Qiao Qian.

Episodes.Title: Defense Formation
Episodes.Description: When Han Li is working on his dwelling, a bunny sneaks into his dwelling. He's disappointed with the current defense formation he has. With the Twin-Eyed Mouse's guidance, he travels to Yuanwu to search for a proper defense formation. In the auction, everyone is wearing a robe with a mask. Han Li puts his 1,000-year-old herb up for auction. A young man, Qi Yun Xiao, wishes to exchange it with his formation but fails. Han Li notices that someone is tailing the young man.

Episodes.Title: More to It Than Meets the Eye
Episodes.Description: Yan Clan Stronghold is in upheaval. Once a century-old clan devoted to eradicating evil and upholding the righteous path, how can they now turn to the demonic way? However, every voice of dissent is suppressed by the clan leader, and in the end, Yan Clan Stronghold's defection to the Ghastly Spirit Sect became a foregone conclusion. They send wedding invitations of Yan Ru Yan and Wang Chan to the Seven Sects. Nangong Wan senses that something is amiss.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding
Episodes.Description: Han Li encounters Mo Cai Huan being harassed in the city streets. He swiftly knocks out the lecherous medicine dealer. The reunion leaves Mo Cai Huan overwhelmed with conflicting emotions, as she never thought they would meet again.

Episodes.Title: Blood Spirit Array
Episodes.Description: Wang Chan activates the Blood Spirit Array. Luckily, Han Li has a hunch. He escapes with Dong Xuan'er. They use an underground path thanks to Mo Cai Huan's help. Wang Chan prepares to capture them. At the same time, Nangong Wan receives Xuan Yue's report. She confirms that Yan Clan Stronghold has surrendered to the Demon Sects.

Episodes.Title: The Attack of the Demon Army
Episodes.Description: While escaping, Dong Xuan Er runs into Xuan Wu and others who are looking for her. At Xuan Yue and Lv Tian Meng's suggestion, Xuan Wu takes Dong Xuan Er back to Huangfeng Valley first. But Xuan Yue and Lv Tian Meng change their course using an excuse that their sects have asked them to check on a mine. Chen Qiao Qian doesn't suspect them. Halfway there, they run into Han Li, who wakes up from being unconscious. Xuan Yue and Lv Tian Meng, who have an ulterior motive, refuse to let him go back. They create an excuse to make him travel with them. They forcefully bring him to the mine.

Episodes.Title: The Mine
Episodes.Description: Xuan Yue and Lv Tian Meng didn't show up in the mine. Chen Qiao Qian and the rest evacuate toward the cave. They try to make it to the cave before the destruction of the protective array. Outside the cave, Wang Chan, who took his sweet time, realizes that the cave is inaccessible after the collapse. He uses the Earthquake Talisman out of spite. The shaky mine entrance collapses instantly.

Episodes.Title: A Narrow Escape
Episodes.Description: On his way out, Han Li rescues the injured Chen Qiao Qian. He carries her to safety. The intimate connection reminds Chen Qiao Qian of the time Han Li rescued her in the cave. Han Li returns to the Seven Sects Coalition Forces camp to exchange his spirit gems with Elder Chen. He runs into Chen Qiao Qian again. The other Chen disciples traveling with her mock him. When Elder Chen reveals his achievements to them, they stop mocking him.

Episodes.Title: Qi Yun Xiao
Episodes.Description: Qi Yun Xiao introduces his senior, Xin Ru Yin, to Han Li. Han Li can tell that she's the formation master. So, he takes out the teleportation array he found in the mine to show them so that they can take a look at it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Nangong Wan suspects there's more to Elder Han's supposed defection than it appears. Wang Chan introduces Dong Xuan Er to Patriarch Yun Lu, from whom she learns she is the daughter of Yun Lu and Hong Fu. Han Li discovers the corpses of cultivators who met a gruesome end in the palace. Steward Wang sets a trap, sending the Four Mengs to watch Han Li.

Episodes.Title: Planting The Mark
Episodes.Description: The Bloon Cocoon under the Sky Concealing Bell ruptures. Tie Luo turns into a half-bull, half-humanoid demon. After the battle, Han Li discovers the Blood-Condensing Five Element Pill and a broken arm. Tie Luo, who's seriously wounded, escapes by burrowing a tunnel. However, Han Li has planted a tracking mark on him. Han Li intends to use it to locate their den.

Episodes.Title: The Great Battle
Episodes.Description: The guard of the Black Fiend Cult risked his life to fire a warning. Tie Luo transforms into a demon and joins the fight. In the battle, Han Li holds Tie Luo back while Song Meng and Liu Jing stop the ice demon from completing his demonization.

Episodes.Title: Sea of Fire
Episodes.Description: Liu Jing detonates the Explosive Talisman, intending to bring down the man clad in blue and the cult leader together with him. The man clad in blue saves the emperor of Yue in the nick of time. Han Li destroys the roof of the library, helping everyone to escape the sea of fire.

Episodes.Title: Return of Zhang Tie
Episodes.Description: Han Li suspects that Melodious has been possessed by another cultivator. He manages to tricks him into revealing that he is from Spirit Taming Sect of Tiandu. Han Li stops concealing his strength and presses him for answers, but they are interrupted by the man's wife and daughter, to whom the cultivator introduces Han Li as a friend.

Episodes.Title: Colluding With the Enemies
Episodes.Description: Han Li's jade slip arrives at Jingu Plain. Elder Han intercepts it right after that. He even issues an order to inspect and deliver any messages that they received as those at the front are busy with the war. It seems that he has colluded with the enemies...

Episodes.Title: Abandoned Pawns
Episodes.Description: Han Li is exhausted from the constant battles. When he is about to give up, Li Hua Yuan shows up and eliminates the Art of Qianji on his body. Then, Han Li is asked to leave. Only then does he realize that they are not the seeded disciples. They are just abandoned pawns.

Episodes.Title: Inner Demon
Episodes.Description: Nangong Wan brings reinforcements to Huangfeng Valley, but she's too late. She encounters Hong Fu, who's alone. She's paying her respects to Li Hua Yuan's grave. She tries to inquire about Han Li's whereabouts, but Hong Fu has no idea either.

Episodes.Title: Simple Days
Episodes.Description: Han Li discovers his cultivation has regressed to the Qi Refining stage. As he and Nangong Wan recover from their injuries, they spend a period of quiet days together, living simply like ordinary mortals.

Entries.Title: Our Generation
Entries.Description: Lin Yingtao, who grew up in the Mount Qun worksite, encounters Jiang Qiaoxi, the transfer student. Jiang Qiaoxi is a loner. He's transferred to Mount Qun Primary School due to his father's job transfer. Jiang Qiaoxi encounters Yingtao at the principal's office by accident, where she's trying to steal a book. Yingtao misunderstands the encounter and thinks that he's the Grim Reaper. She tries to resolve the crisis by bribing him with candies and requesting her classmates to welcome Jiang Qiaoxi with open arms.

Episodes.Title: Transfer Student
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao, who grew up in the Mount Qun worksite, encounters Jiang Qiaoxi, the transfer student. Jiang Qiaoxi is a loner. He's transferred to Mount Qun Primary School due to his father's job transfer. Jiang Qiaoxi encounters Yingtao at the principal's office by accident, where she's trying to steal a book. Yingtao misunderstands the encounter and thinks that he's the Grim Reaper. She tries to resolve the crisis by bribing him with candies and requesting her classmates to welcome Jiang Qiaoxi with open arms.

Episodes.Title: Falling Out between Old Friends
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao's beloved rabbit dies. She wants to tell Jiang Qiaoxi, who loves the rabbit as much as she does, about it. She finally decides to gather the letters she has written over the years into a notebook and send the notebook to him.

Episodes.Title: A New Chapter at School
Episodes.Description: After transferring to a new school, Lin Yingtao moves with her family to the Dianjian residential compound. The parents warmly welcome them and celebrate their arrival. Meanwhile, Jiang Qiaoxi’s behavior is puzzling. He shows care for Yingtao in front of others, yet privately probes her feelings toward him.

Episodes.Title: Gossip
Episodes.Description: Yu Qiao suggests going to the aquarium which Qin Yeyun wants to go but Yu Qiao and Yingtao are the only ones who go there. Cen Xiaoman and Fei Linge take pictures of Yu Qiao and Yingtao having fun and gossip about their relationship.

Episodes.Title: The Cat and the Rabbit
Episodes.Description: Yingtao finds a stray cat in the school's courtyard. She never expects Jiang Qiaoxi to be its secret owner. Yingtao sees the gentle look on his face when he cares for the cat. She's reminded of her rabbit, which he neglected.

Episodes.Title: Power of Keeping Promises
Episodes.Description: Jiang Qiaoxi tells Yingtao what happened in the past. He once ran away from home in order to keep the promise he made to him, but he failed. Yingtao is heartbroken upon hearing that.

Episodes.Title: Rumors
Episodes.Description: The students misunderstand the relationship between Lin Yingtao and Yu Qiao. Puzzled by the weird looks from them, they decide to ask Fei Linge about it.

Episodes.Title: Special Training
Episodes.Description: Ying Tao and Yu Qiao join the after-school tuition class together. Physics is a tough subject for her. She always fails to understand it. Yu Qiao believs that one has to have fun in order to learn. He brings Ying Tao outside for her to experience the charm of Physics.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Baby
Episodes.Description: Ying Tao is unhappy that Qin Ye Yun stood her up but she doesn't know that Qin Ye Yun is absent because his father has been hospitalized. Thus, Ying Tao doesn't know how to comfort Qin Ye Yun...

Episodes.Title: Unspoken Feelings
Episodes.Description: Jiang Qiao Xi finally gathers the courage to tell his uninvolved father how he has felt all these years. At the same time, Lin Ying Tao stands up to Chen Xiao Man's accusations and provocations by boldly speaking her mind.

Episodes.Title: You Are My Hero
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao faces Liang Hongfei bravely. Jiang Qiaoxi gives Yingtao a letter through the window after finding out what she did for him.

Episodes.Title: Choosing His Own Path
Episodes.Description: Under Yingtao's care and encouragement, Jiang Qiaoxi completes the Mathematical Olympiad exam despite feeling unwell.

Episodes.Title: The Freedom He Deserves
Episodes.Description: Seeing how much Lin Yingtao cares for him, Jiang Qiaoxi decides to reclaim his life.

Episodes.Title: Attachment
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao is mad at Jiang Qiaoxi for not telling her that he'll be studying abroad. When she finds out about Jiang Qiaoxi's determination, she chooses to respect his decision.

Episodes.Title: Well Wishes
Episodes.Description: Jiang Qiaoxi and Lin Yingtao don't talk as often as they used to. Preoccupied with her studies and exam preparation, Yingtao doesn't notice the adults are keeping something from her.

Episodes.Title: University Check-in
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao heads to university on her own, only to find herself assigned to a dorm with senior students. She struggles to connect with them, feeling the weight of their age gap.

Episodes.Title: Childhood Sweethearts
Episodes.Description: A male student wants to be friends with Lin Yingtao. Yingtao remains unmoved. Her feelings for Jiang Qiaoxi have never changed.

Episodes.Title: Lost Contact
Episodes.Description: Cai Fangyuan sees a recent picture of Jiang Qiaoxi online. Qin Yeyun tells the gang not to tell Yingtao about it...

Episodes.Title: Our Time Apart
Episodes.Description: Yu Qiao tells Lin Yingtao where Jiang Qiaoxi is. With her parents' support, Yingtao travels to Hong Kong alone.

Episodes.Title: Running Away
Episodes.Description: Yingtao forces Jiang Qiaoxi to confront his true feelings, leaving him so emotionally overwhelmed that he runs away. With help from his young landlord, Yingtao tracks him down near the construction site.

Episodes.Title: Facing It Together
Episodes.Description: Tired of waiting for him to open up, Yingtao bares her heart to Jiang Qiaoxi — reminding him she loves him just as he is.

Episodes.Title: Relationship Announced
Episodes.Description: Under the Ferris wheel, Jiang Qiaoxi talks about his past, which he cried inside a Ferris wheel's cabin alone.

Episodes.Title: Living Well
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao and Jiang Qiaoxi treat his young landlord, who has been looking after Jiang Qiaoxi, to a meal. The landlord feels genuinely happy for Jiang Qiaoxi.

Episodes.Title: A Better Version of Myself
Episodes.Description: Lin Yingtao and Jiang Qiaoxi have a long-distance relationship. They bond through making video calls frequently. They stare out at each of their windows respectively, yet their hearts inch closer.

Entries.Title: Love in the Edge of Divorce
FEUD
Entries.Description: Bai Jiusi first meets Li Qingyue and follows her back to the Jingyun Sect. The next day, Li Qingyue is accidentally placed in confinement.

Episodes.Title: Losing One's Head
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi first meets Li Qingyue and follows her back to the Jingyun Sect. The next day, Li Qingyue is accidentally placed in confinement.

Episodes.Title: Marrying a Mortal
Episodes.Description: A date is set for Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi’s wedding. Zhang Suan opens up to Li Qingyue. On her wedding day, Li Qingyue ascends to the Nine Heavens.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Night
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi introduces Li Qingyue to everyone. The next day, she finds herself in danger on her way back — but Bai Jiusi rescues her.

Episodes.Title: Hope
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi has his doubts about Li Qingyue’s identity, and tests her repeatedly. Fan Ling'er is consumed with jealousy toward Li Qingyue.

Episodes.Title: Abnormality
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi investigates the assault on Li Qingyue’s life. Zhang Suan learns of Bai Jiusi’s past. Bai Jiusi tests Li Qingyue again.

Episodes.Title: Sun Fruit
Episodes.Description: A critically wounded Li Qingyue is on the brink of death — and Bai Jiusi strives to save her. While in seclusion, he recalls his tragic past.

Episodes.Title: The Abyss
Episodes.Description: Fan Ling'er reveals the truth to Li Qingyue. A jeopardized Li Qingyue enters the Forbidden Ruins, and Bai Jiusi breaks out of seclusion to save her.

Episodes.Title: Missing
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi go on a mission to capture Honglian. To save Li Qingyue, Bai Jiusi enters into the illusion where she's trapped.

Episodes.Title: Grave Mistake
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi fiercely resists the ice barrier but is severely injured. At a critical moment, Li Qingyue uses the fire technique to repel Honglian.

Episodes.Title: Four Spirits Grandmistress
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue is taken prisoner. When Bai Jiusi questions her, she is ready to harm herself to prove her identity.

Episodes.Title: Activating the Seal
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi hesitates to seal away Li Qingyue. Zhang Suan tries but fails to rescue her. As the sealing begins, Li Qingyue experiences terrible pain.

Episodes.Title: Dying Together
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi face off as immortals and mortals clash. Li Qingyue recalls their shared past.

Episodes.Title: A Life of Servitude
Episodes.Description: Hua Ruyue and Bai Jiusi are consumed by the trials of betrayed love. Hua Ruyue interferes with the karma of mortals — and suffers the consequences.

Episodes.Title: Help Meng Changqin
Episodes.Description: Hua Ruyue casts a spell to save Meng Changqin. A sulking Bai Jiusi goes on a blind date, and Hua Ruyue apologizes to him.

Episodes.Title: Killing the Drought Dragon
Episodes.Description: Hua Ruyue and Bai Jiusi reconcile. Hua Ruyue helps Meng Changqin slay the dragon but Bai Jiusi seals her spiritual power.

Episodes.Title: 10-Year Deal
Episodes.Description: Fan Ling'er opens up about her connection to Li Qingyue. Bai Jiusi and Li Qingyue agree to live together as mortals for 10 years.

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: A stranger's kindness stirs Bai Jiusi’s heart. His relationship with Li Qingyue warms up.

Episodes.Title: Like a Mortal
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi uses his power to save Lin Fan’s son, and suffers the consequences. He investigates the evil spirit, leaving Li Qingyue deeply moved.

Episodes.Title: Barrier
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi and Li Qingyue are caught in the evil spirit's spell. As Li Qingyue takes care of Bai Jiusi, the two suspect a trap.

Episodes.Title: Battle Against the Evil Spirit
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi discuss their past and present, easing tensions. Li Qingyue battles the evil spirit alone until Bai Jiusi shows up.

Episodes.Title: Shocking Truth
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue reveals the reason behind the plot to kill Bai Jiusi. Bai Jiusi’s soul returns, forbidding his disciples from harming Li Qingyue.

Episodes.Title: The Battle of Immortals
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi tries to go back in time to find the truth. Longyuan gathers his forces to start a war between immortals and mortals. Li Qingyue reminisces.

Episodes.Title: The Sad Past
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi enters a time tunnel toward the past. Grief-stricken after losing her child, Hua Ruyue escapes with help from Meng Changqin.

Episodes.Title: The Resurrection Formation
Episodes.Description: Hua Ruyue's plan is frustrated by Bai Jiusi's intervention. Upon regaining consciousness, Bai Jiusi orders the troops to withdraw.

Episodes.Title: More Than Meets the Eye
Episodes.Description: Hua Ruyue suspects someone is using her to get to Bai Jiusi. Qingyang is killed. Hua Ruyue goes to the Nine Heavens to seek justice, shocking everyone.

Episodes.Title: Ascend
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi orders the barrier lifted, allowing the members of the Jingyun Sect in. Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi scheme.

Episodes.Title: The Real Objective
Episodes.Description: Bai Jiusi, Hua Ruyue and Xiao Jingshan face off. Bai Jiusi awakens in the Ninth Heaven with a transformed temperament.

Episodes.Title: Memory Loss
Episodes.Description: Great Wilderness Stele is restored, deceiving Hua Ruyue and Bai Jiusi. As the Hell Ruins seal weakens, Hua Ruyue directs everyone to split up.

Episodes.Title: Entering the Illusory Realm
Episodes.Description: Souls are being stolen — Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi investigate. Xiao Jingshan incites the people to attack them.

Episodes.Title: False Happiness
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue sets up a barrier for protection and discusses next steps. Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi get stuck in the Yin-Yang formation.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: A severely injured Bai Jiusi decides to sacrifice himself. Li Qingyue combines the power of two swords to defeat Xiao Jingshan.

Episodes.Title: Changing the Past
Episodes.Description: Li Qingyue travels through time in an effort to eliminate regrets, and ends up embarking on a journey to find Bai Jiusi.

Entries.Title: Reborn at 18: The Great-Grandma Takes Charge
The Princess's Gambit
Entries.Description: On her way to be married, Jiang Taohua meets Shen Zaiye. Later, fearing the wedding might be called off, she resolves to take action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: On her way to be married, Jiang Taohua meets Shen Zaiye. Later, fearing the wedding might be called off, she resolves to take action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jiang Taohua marries Shen Zaiye willingly, but he suspects she may have ulterior motives. On their wedding day, he sets a trap to humiliate her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye test each other in a tense standoff. After Xue Ran is killed, Shen Zai Ye takes swift action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua escapes from the Crown Prince's residence and seeks help from Mu Wu Xia. She then offers to help Shen Zai Ye take on Meng Zhen Zhen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye come up with a scheme. On the wedding day, Meng Zhen Zhen stirs trouble, and Jiang Tao Hua waits for an opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye places Meng Zhen Zhen under house arrest. The Crown Prince tries to bring him down — but Shen uncovers the source of the counterfeit money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye investigate a gambling house. Unaware that danger is closing in, they elude the Crown Prince.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The Crown Prince destroys the evidence. Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye stumble upon some counterfeit money and decide to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Xiang Qing Ying and Mu Wu Xia follow Shen Zai Ye's tracks into the mountains — and find Shen Zai Ye and Jiang Tao Hua.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: With their whereabouts discovered, Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye distract the ambushers while Mu Wu Xia and Xiang Qing Ying lead the villagers to safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye and Jiang Tao Hua discover the location of the silver mine and relocate the planned hunt. Meng Huai Jin schemes against them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Xiang Qing Ying comforts Mu Wu Xia. Shen Zai Ye and Jiang Tao Hua are trapped. After escaping, they decide to team up to confront Empress Lu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye is ambushed in the mine — but Mu Wu Xia comes to the rescue. Meanwhile, Jiang Tao Hua takes bold risks to earn Shen Zai Ye's trust.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After defeating the Crown Prince, Shen Zai Ye continues dealing with the Meng family and grows closer to Jiang Tao Hua.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Meng Zhen Zhen unsuccessfully tries to poison Shen Zai Ye, who takes this opportunity to wipe out other threats hiding within his household.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua makes a shocking discovery. Shen Zai Ye targets a key enemy but is injured trying to capture them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Xiang Qing Ying befriends Li Jiao Han, and Mu Wu Xia becomes jealous. Jiang Tao Hua confides in Shen Zai Ye, who chooses to trust her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua saves Mu Wu Xia, but Shen Zai Ye misunderstands the situation. Later, Shen Zai Ye rescues Jiang Tao Hua.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye learns the truth and struggles with remorse. Jiang Tao Hua awakens from her coma only to find she suffers from amnesia.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye reunites with Jiang Tao Hua, yet she remains cold toward him. Shen Zai Ye traps the delegation from Beiyuan, and Empress Lu suddenly shows up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye becomes aware of Jiang Tao Hua's amnesia and decides to help her recover her memory. Jiang Tao Hua discovers a new clue in the secret room.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: The villainous Meng Zhen Zhen kidnaps Jiang Tao Hua. After learning about this, Shen Zai Ye rushes to her rescue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua unexpectedly regains her memory. Li Jiao Han dies, and Shen Zai Ye seizes the opportunity to restore the imperial examination.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Empress Lu begins implementing her plan. Jiang Tao Hua tries to cut ties with Shen Zai Ye. Meanwhile, Mu Wu Yin plots with Meng Zhen Zhen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Mu Wu Xia is charged for the murder of the Second Prince and placed under house arrest. Shen Zai Ye secretly investigates the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye remains skeptical about the murder of the Second Prince. Meng Zhen Zhen strikes a deal with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye forces Mu Wu Yin to drop out of the imperial examination. Mu Wu Yin decides to target Mu Wu Xia. Shen Zai Ye heads to Beiyuan for the antidote.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye rush to Luocheng. Empress Lu teams up with Mu Wu Yin to sabotage their plans, and involves Mu Wu Xia and Xiang Qing Ying.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua is attacked — but Shen Zai Ye comes to the rescue. Together, they uncover a new secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: When explosions rock the city, Empress Lu escapes. She then seals the city off — but Shen Zai Ye leads the rest of the inhabitants to break out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Mu Wu Xia presents evidence of Mu Wu Yin's treason. Jiang Tao Hua and Shen Zai Ye pledge their love to each other. Mu Wu Yin imprisons Empress Lu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: The King of Qi is forced to yield to Mu Wu Yin. Shen Zai Ye and Mu Wu Xia mobilize troops to rescue him. Empress Lu is exposed at the succession ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Mu Wu Yin and Empress Lu are toppled. Mu Wu Xia and Xiang Qing Ying pledge their love. Meng Zhong Yan confesses — then kills himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye unveils his true identity, vindicating the Xie family. Empress Lu reemerges and attempts to stir up trouble again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Jiang Tao Hua passes Qian Mo Chen's test. Shen Zai Ye is poisoned while testing some medicine, leaving Jiang Tao Hua heartbroken and helpless.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Shen Zai Ye sets a trap to lure Empress Lu. Qian Mo Chen and Empress Lu die together. Shen Zai Ye and Jiang Tao Hua finally get married.

Entries.Title: Reborn
Entries.Description: In the summer of 2007, 17-year-old Qiao Qingyu moved with her family from Shunyun to Huanzhou to start a new life.

Episodes.Title: Beiyu's Younger Sister
Episodes.Description: In the summer of 2007, 17-year-old Qiao Qingyu moved with her family from Shunyun to Huanzhou to start a new life.

Episodes.Title: Words Can Kill
Episodes.Description: Qingyu insisted that Beiyu died of appendicitis. Ming Sheng said that his father was the director of the hospital where Beiyu stayed in, implying that he could know the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Clues in Nanqiao Village
Episodes.Description: Qingyu and her family returned to Nanqiao Village to visit their grandparents. Qingyu examined the traces that Beiyu left in the house, trying to know more about Beiyu.

Episodes.Title: Lies or Truth
Episodes.Description: Ms. Xiu Zhen told Qingyu that she didn't know why Beiyu died, but Beiyu had a miscarriage. Beiyu refused to tell who the father of the child was until her death.

Episodes.Title: Boyfriend from Nanqiao Village
Episodes.Description: Qingyu learned that rumors about her sister were not spread by Ming Sheng. She began to change her mind about Ming Sheng.

Episodes.Title: The Rumored Beiyu
Episodes.Description: He Fei Hai recalled his memory of Beiyu. At first, Beiyu fought back against bullying. But gradually, She became just like the rumors said.

Episodes.Title: The Call from Nanqiao Village
Episodes.Description: With the help of Wang Mumu, Qingyu escaped from Hei's entanglement. Hei then went to Qiao's Noodle House instead.

Episodes.Title: You Have Me
Episodes.Description: Qingyu delivered food to the building opposite to her, and found that Ming Sheng lived there. In order to repay Ming Sheng's protection, Qingyu helped him tidy up his room.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Music Box
Episodes.Description: Qingyu and her family returned to Nanqiao Village to celebrate the New Year and attended Jinrui's wedding. Qingyu was curious when she saw the dancing doll hanging in Jinrui's car.

Episodes.Title: Never to Be Forgotten
Episodes.Description: In front of the grave of Beiyu, Qingyu promised to make the ones who hurt Beiyu pay the price. Qingyu wrote a letter to reveal Jinrui's fault and prepared to distribute it on the wedding day.

Episodes.Title: The Broken Wedding
Episodes.Description: Qingyu attended Jinrui's wedding. When it was time to distribute candy, Qingyu put the candy box at the venue and left.

Episodes.Title: Where You Go, I Go
Episodes.Description: Qingyu gave her lucky charm to Ming Sheng as a gratitude for allowing her stay in his house. Ming Sheng gave Qingyu a gift in return.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Is Beautiful Tonight
Episodes.Description: Ming Sheng and Qingyu made a pinky promise to leave Huanzhou together. But Qingyu had already decided to leave alone.

Episodes.Title: Running Out of Courage
Episodes.Description: Qiao Lusheng insisted on taking Qingyu to Nanqiao Village to apologize for her mistakes. Li Fanghao strongly opposed it, but Qingyu expressed her willingness to do so.

Episodes.Title: Meet You At the Tree
Episodes.Description: Qingyu sneaked out to meet Ming Sheng under the big tree. The two agreed to return to their normal lives without interfering each other anymore.

Episodes.Title: Beiyu's Wish
Episodes.Description: Before Jinrui left Huanzhou, he came to the school to say goodbye to Qing Yu. He returned Beiyu's music box to Qingyu, hoping that she could fulfill Beiyu’s wish.

Episodes.Title: Every Family Has Its Troubles
Episodes.Description: Wang Mumu accidentally fell down the stairs due to violence from her father. Mumu’s ankle was injured, causing her unable to perform on stage. Qingyu arrived in time to help, and hence fulfilled her own dream of dancing.

Episodes.Title: I Lied. I Have an Umbrella
Episodes.Description: Ming Sheng ran into Qingyu in the hospital and told her that he was going to study medicine in France. In the rain, Ming Sheng suggested to lend Qingyu an umbrella, but Qingyu refused because they will never meet again.

Episodes.Title: Beiyu's DV
Episodes.Description: Doctor Le Fan recalled Beiyu's story to Qingyu, and Qingyu realized that Beiyu did not die of AIDS, but committed suicide by jumping into the sea.

Episodes.Title: Li Fanghao's Outburst
Episodes.Description: Qingyu and the family returned to Nanqiao Village to keep vigil for her grandfather. Qingyu's uncle and aunt made things difficult for them. Li Fanghao could not bear it anymore and slapped Qingyu's aunt.

Episodes.Title: I'm Glad We Met
Episodes.Description: After the dance competition, Qingyu and Ming Sheng spent a wonderful time together in amusement park. They played with fireworks sticks at the beach, and Qingyu made three wishes.

Episodes.Title: I'll Remember You Forever
Episodes.Description: Ming Sheng is preparing to go to Beining for the overseas study examination. At the same time, Qingyu is preparing for the college entrance examination.

Episodes.Title: I'll Always Be Here When You Turn Back
Episodes.Description: Qingyu spent a colorful college life. Mumu told Qingyu that Ming Sheng had returned to China. Qingyu sent a message to Ming Sheng, but received no reply.

Entries.Title: Flourished Peony
Entries.Description: He Wei Fang agrees to marry Liu Chang to save her mother, but her life after marriage has been tough. Despite the hardships, she remains composed and patient. One day, the Liu family goes behind her back and digs up the prized peonies in her courtyard for a flower banquet. Distraught, she resolves to protect the keepsakes left by her mother.

Episodes.Title: A Marriage of Convenience
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang agrees to marry Liu Chang to save her mother, but her life after marriage has been tough. Despite the hardships, she remains composed and patient. One day, the Liu family goes behind her back and digs up the prized peonies in her courtyard for a flower banquet. Distraught, she resolves to protect the keepsakes left by her mother.

Episodes.Title: Flower Banquet
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang and the County Princess attend the Yang family's flower banquet. The County Princess keeps making life difficult for He Wei Fang.

Episodes.Title: A Certain Divorce
Episodes.Description: Liu Shen finds out that He Wei Fang is visiting the shops. He's afraid that she might foil his plan of selling the shops. He goes to stop her. During the chaos, Yu Lu, her servant, falls into the water while trying to defend her mistress. He Wei Fang kneels and begs the Liu family to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Rekindling Old Flames
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang pledges his support to the County Princess and helps her arrange a private meeting with Liu Chang. At the Shuiyu Pavilion, the County Princess and Liu Chang reminisce about their past relationship, while He Wei Fang begins to execute her plans.

Episodes.Title: Leaving the Liu Residence
Episodes.Description: Liu Chang barges into He Wei Fang's room after getting drunk. He intends to force himself upon her. He Wei Fang is hurt during the struggle. After that, He Wei Fang injures herself with a pair of scissors on purpose as she seeks Jiang Chang Yang's aid.

Episodes.Title: Starting Anew
Episodes.Description: Realizing she no longer has a home, He Wei Fang deliberately leaves her hairpin at the edge of a cliff. Liu Shen's men find the hairpin and conclude she has fallen to her death. Afterward, He Wei Fang puts on plain clothes and sets out to begin a new chapter of her life.

Episodes.Title: Forced Fate
Episodes.Description: After many days of inquiry, He Wei Fang finds out that Wanguan Hall is able to help people handle household registers...

Episodes.Title: Business Opportunity
Episodes.Description: It's difficult to make a living in Chang'an. He Wei Fang decides to start a business with her gardening skills.

Episodes.Title: Marriage
Episodes.Description: Li You Zhen stops her father, King Ning, from betrothing her to Jiang Chang Yang. She kneels and begs for his forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: Sincerity
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang arrives at the Jiang's Residence to care for the Jade Orchid and happens to witness the grand ceremony of opening the warehouse. She is astonished by Jiang Chang Yang's extravagant style of receiving gifts.

Episodes.Title: Relentless Pester
Episodes.Description: When Sheng Yi is busy at the flower stall, her ex-husband Wang Qing suddenly shows up and relentlessly pesters her.

Episodes.Title: Swearing An Oath
Episodes.Description: Da Fu chases away the troublemakers with her excellent martial arts. Both He Wei Fang and Sheng Yi like Da Fu's straightforward personality.

Episodes.Title: Keeping A Secret
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang leaves the city to harvest peonies. She witnesses Jiang Chang Yang murdering Imperial Academy's Xu Zu Ping by accident.

Episodes.Title: Self-sufficient
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang rejects the Flower Association leader's suggestion of an even profit split so the Flower Association bans them from purchasing fertilizers. Sheng Yi suggests apologizing to the association, but He Wei Fang decides to make her own fertilizer instead.

Episodes.Title: Their Wager
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang confides in He Wei Fang, sharing his feelings about his father's betrayal and his aversion to marriage. They wager on who will break their vow and get married first.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Encounters
Episodes.Description: Chuan Yu invites He Wei Fang to the Jiang Residence and claims Jiang Chang Yang wants to discuss his aunt with her. However, he locks Mu Dan inside a pitch-black room.

Episodes.Title: Life and Death
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang is pursued by a masked assassin in the wilderness. He Wei Fang shouts for help, but she fails to escape from the assassin. The assassin raises the blade in his hand and prepares to stab He Wei Fang.

Episodes.Title: The Mastermind
Episodes.Description: The flowers in the shop are infested with pests. Upon investigation, Mu Dan discovers that someone has planted insect eggs into the fertilizer.

Episodes.Title: Being Independent
Episodes.Description: Sheng Yi is persuaded by Wang Qing. She thinks that women should live their lives with a mate. He Wei Fang persuades Sheng Yi patiently. She tells her that being independent is more important than getting married.

Episodes.Title: Cancelling the Marriage
Episodes.Description: Liu Chang asks King Ning to cancel his marriage with Li You Zhen. He thinks it's unfair to marry her if he cannot love her wholeheartedly. Because of that, he is willing to resign as the assistant minister of the Ministry of Revenue.

Episodes.Title: Identity Exposed
Episodes.Description: Li You Zhen learns that Liu Chang has been frequenting a tavern, and directly across the street is Blooming Abode, which turns out to be He Wei Fang's business. Li You Zhen confronts the Liu family and demands that Liu Shen report He Wei Fang's true identity to the authorities.

Episodes.Title: Senteced to Slavery
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang is sentenced to serve as a government slave in the military. The camp's commanding officer uses the slaves as live targets to train the recruits in archery.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Sheng Yi returns to the temple ruins where she started the business with Mu Dan and prays for the deity to let Mu Dan return safely. Mu Dan appears and questions Sheng Yi as to why she betrayed her.

Episodes.Title: Getting Back Blooming Abode
Episodes.Description: Wang Qing kneels and begs Mu Dan for help. Mu Dan agrees to help him with the condition that he returns Blooming Abode to her and apologizes to Sheng Yi.

Episodes.Title: Joining Hands
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang reminds He Wei Fang that behind the moldy grain issue in the West Market lies an intricate and complex network. He Wei Fang understands what Jiang Chang Yang is implying. She understands that he's making preparations to topple the corrupt officials. They decide to join hands.

Episodes.Title: Opening of the Branch
Episodes.Description: Blooming Abode's branch is officially opened in the Eastern market. He Wei Fang and Da Fu dress up to welcome their customers.

Episodes.Title: The Attempted Assassination on Jiang Chang Yang
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang and Geng Chun bump into four young men acting suspiciously at Huanyun Pavilion. Wei Fang senses that the scrolls they carry might be concealing weapons. Meanwhile, Jiang Chang Yang is in a secret meeting with the Emperor inside the pavilion.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Preparation
Episodes.Description: King Ning orders Jiang Chang Yang to hand over He Wei Fang. As the situation is dire, Jiang Chang Yang tells King Ning that he is preparing to take He Wei Fang as his concubine.

Episodes.Title: Recovering Fang Garden
Episodes.Description: Liu Chang will marry the county princess soon. Leader Lv and his flower association have taken up the important task of preparing fresh flowers for the occasion. Leader Lv seeks help from He Wei Fang.

Episodes.Title: Married
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang and Mu Dan complete their wedding according to the customs under Dean Xu's supervision to become a married couple.

Episodes.Title: Taking A Concubine
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang is forced by King Ning to marry Lian Zhou as his concubine. After the wedding banquet, he hides in He Wei Fang's room. They wait for Lian Zhou to come over so they can put on a planned show to fool her.

Episodes.Title: Opening of Fang Garden
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang finds Liu Lang, Sheng Yi's younger brother, at the corner of the street. Liu Lang is coughing and has shortness of breath. He Wei Fang decides to take him back to Fang Garden to seek treatment.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Consumed by jealousy over He Wei Fang's exclusive favor, Lian Zhou tries to convince Da Fu to falsely accuse He Wei Fang of stealing her jewelry.

Episodes.Title: Shut Down Qingshu Pavilion
Episodes.Description: Liu Chang meets with He Wei Fang, which makes the Princess seethe with jealousy. She arranges for someone to slander He Wei Fang, accusing her that the Tresses Pill in her shop has killed Madam Wu.

Episodes.Title: Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang senses that Zhao Cai and Lian Zhou are plotting something. Thus, she tails Lian Zhou. She finds out why she approached Jiang Chang Yang.

Episodes.Title: Xiao Xue Xi's Visit
Episodes.Description: Xiao Xue Xi, the daughter of General Xiao, the Governor of Hexi, arrives in the capital. King Ning plans to arrange a marriage between her and Pei Zhong, a descendant of a noble family. Though Pei Zhong is deeply taken with Xue Xi, he fears she has feelings for her childhood friend, Jiang Chang Yang. This leads him to come up with a devious plan.

Episodes.Title: Searching Wanguan Hall
Episodes.Description: Liu Chang orders his men to search Wanguan Hall when Jiang Chang Yang is being imprisoned. He Wei Fang asks Da Fu to inform Miss Yun while she attempts to slow Liu Chang down.

Episodes.Title: Fire at the Fang Garden
Episodes.Description: The Fang Garden catches on fire. Mu Dan rushes in with no regard for her own safety to save the people inside. When Jiang Chang Yang finds out, he runs into the fire to look for He Wei Fang. But he passes out from inhaling too much smoke.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang spends Xue Xi's birthday with her. Fueled by a bit of Dutch courage, Xue Xi confesses her feelings for Jiang Chang Yang.

Episodes.Title: Admission of Arson
Episodes.Description: The pirate points out in court that he was instructed by Princess Li You Zhen. Li You Zhen worries that it will affect King Ning if things get out of hand. Thus, she admits that she's the culprit behind the fire.

Episodes.Title: Secret Chamber
Episodes.Description: King Ning orders Liu Chang to conduct a surprise raid on Jiang Chang Yang's residence, where they uncover a hidden chamber.

Episodes.Title: Peerless Youthful Beauty
Episodes.Description: Foreign envoys and officials gather at the Imperial Garden to admire the blooming snow peonies. Everyone has high praise for the view. The emperor is delighted. He grants He Wei Fang a plaque with the writing "Peerless Youthful Beauty" on it.

Episodes.Title: Kidnapping
Episodes.Description: Pei Zhong blames Jiang Chang Yang for ruining his plans with Xue Xi, so he kidnaps He Wei Fang to get back at him. As soon as Jiang Chang Yang finds out, he immediately gathers his men to confront Pei Zhong.

Episodes.Title: Search of the Merchant Ship
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang informs Vice Minister Lu to search the merchant ship escorted by Liu Chang. The search uncovers a large number of Buddha statues forged from copper and iron. When questioned by the Emperor, King Ning, trying to cover up his secret weapon production, claims that Liu Chang will be stripped of his rank.

Episodes.Title: Death of Her Mother
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang finds out that there might be more to her mother's death than meets the eye. Thus, she investigates the background of Mr. Wu.

Episodes.Title: Robbed
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang, Xiao Chun, and Da Fu are making a delivery for their customer and encounter bandits along the way. After receiving news from Liu Lang, Jiang Chang Yang rushes to save them.

Episodes.Title: Saving Lives, Serving the Nation
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang reopens Fang Garden and establishes Wuyong Clinic, making it easier for the poor to seek medical treatment.

Episodes.Title: Stripped of His Position
Episodes.Description: The emperor is mad at Jiang Chang Yang for taking bribes. He strips him of his position as Flower Bird Envoy. At the same time, he seizes all of his assets.

Episodes.Title: Divorce Letter
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang is worried that his plan will bring Mu Dan harm so he gives her the divorce letter.

Episodes.Title: Spring Imperial Exam
Episodes.Description: The spring imperial exam is nearing. King Ning and his faction cut the lamp oil supply to interrupt modest scholars from studying for the exam. He Wei Fang teaches them how to create lamp oil and thinks of a way to transport a large amount of it into the Capital.

Episodes.Title: The Condemnation of King Ning
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of Jiang Chang Yang's plan, He Wei Fang suggests hosting the banquet at Fang Garden to facilitate their scheme. During the banquet, Zhang Qian leads the newly appointed young officials in reciting a poem condemning corrupt officials, a pointed critique aimed squarely at King Ning.

Episodes.Title: Trapped in Liu Residence
Episodes.Description: Jiang Chang Yang is killed by King Ning. He Wei Fang is knocked out by Liu Chang and brought back to his residence. When she wakes up, she finds out she is tied to a bed in handcuffs and shackles.

Episodes.Title: Escaping Liu Residence
Episodes.Description: Li You Zhen releases He Wei Fang. He Wei Fang escapes to Huanyun Pavilion. She puts up the secret signal previously agreed upon with Jiang Chang Yang.

Episodes.Title: Reunited
Episodes.Description: Magistrate Du hires some people to take revenge on He Wei Fang. He Wei Fang hides in an umbrella workshop. Someone suddenly appears during the crisis and knocks out everyone who tries to capture He Wei Fang.

Episodes.Title: Clash of Armies
Episodes.Description: The Hedong army's granaries and supplies are burned to ashes by King Ning's men. Upon learning that Jiang Chang Yang's forces are running low on provisions at the frontlines, He Wei Fang organizes the collection of military supplies and delivers them to the battlefield via large merchant ships.

Episodes.Title: Traveling South
Episodes.Description: He Wei Fang and Jiang Chang Yang plan to travel south to do business. They reluctantly bid farewell to everyone from Fang Garden.

Entries.Title: The Glory
Entries.Description: In early winter, Zhuang Hanyan, the third daughter of the Zhuang family, fainted in front of the Zhuang family's house with wounds all over her body. Fu Yunxi, the Vice Minister of Judicial Review, comes and questions about the situation. This man, Fu Yunxi, is indeed the future husband of Zhuang Hanyan. Their marriage was decided by their parents before birth.

Episodes.Title: Escape Back to the Capital
Episodes.Description: In early winter, Zhuang Hanyan, the third daughter of the Zhuang family, fainted in front of the Zhuang family's house with wounds all over her body. Fu Yunxi, the Vice Minister of Judicial Review, comes and questions about the situation. This man, Fu Yunxi, is indeed the future husband of Zhuang Hanyan. Their marriage was decided by their parents before birth.

Episodes.Title: Unsolved Mystery
Episodes.Description: Fu Yunxi sees through Zhuang Hanyan's disguise and purpose. Zhuang Hanyan notices the threat brought by Fu Yunxi, so she sends her friend Chai Jing to investigate him secretly.

Episodes.Title: Vindication
Episodes.Description: Taoist Duan pushed Zhuang Hanyan into a desperate situation. Zhuang Hanyan did not panic, but pressed on step by step, forcing Taoist Duan to admit his crime of framing the innocent.

Episodes.Title: Fu's Residence Burned Down
Episodes.Description: Chai Jing went to kill Fu Yunxi, but he managed to escape. Chai Jing then set fire to Fu's residence.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Yushan saw Zhuang Hanyan talking to Fu Yunxi late at night, and her jealousy grew even stronger. She sent someone to find the bedding of a smallpox patient, hoping to infect Zhuang Hanyan with smallpox.

Episodes.Title: Ruan Xiwen's Secret
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan wanted to find out her mother's secret, so she agreed to stay in the Zhuang Resdence to collect information for Fu Yunxi.

Episodes.Title: To Protect Her Mother
Episodes.Description: Ruan Xiwen was confined to Jianjia Chamber, and Zhuang Hanyan came to protect her mother. Ruan Xiwen was moved, but still pretended to be indifferent.

Episodes.Title: Carried Away
Episodes.Description: Zhou Ruyin and her son were jealous of Zhuang Hanyan's popularity in Yinan Guild Hall, so they planned a rally for Zhuang Yuchi.

Episodes.Title: Crossing the Line
Episodes.Description: Zhou Ruyin colluded with Yang Ping and conspired to reopen the old case of Zhang Youchang and his wife in Danzhou.

Episodes.Title: Secret Past
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan regained her freedom, but could not find any trace of Chai Jing.

Episodes.Title: The Precarious Mansion
Episodes.Description:
On the first day of the Lunar New Year, officials enter the palace to meet the emperor, but Zhuang Shiyang and the twelve officials were detained in the

palace.

Episodes.Title: Pursuing the Truth
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan is determined to resolve the crisis of the Zhuang family. She convinced everyone in the family, confronts Yuwen Changan, and asks for the truth.

Episodes.Title: Save the Family
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan ventured into prison to meet Zhuang Shiyang, and learned that the mystery of the secret passage might be related to the missing Prince Wu Youzhi.

Episodes.Title: Take Charge of the Household
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan sees through her father's hypocrisy. She volunteers to take over the management of the Zhuang family in order to consolidate the family's status.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Kiss
Episodes.Description: At the Lantern Festival, Zhuang Yushan was drunk and untied a mad horse. Zhuang Hanyan tried to tame the mad horse, and Fu Yunxi rushed in to help.

Episodes.Title: True Thoughts
Episodes.Description: Ruan Xiwen hopes to decide on Zhuang Hanyan's marriage before she leaves the Zhuang family. Zhuang Hanyan tries to find out Fu Yunxi's true thoughts.

Episodes.Title: Propose Conditions
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan doubts whether Fu Yunxi is reliable. After careful consideration, she puts forward conditions to Fu Yunxi.

Episodes.Title: Leave the Capital
Episodes.Description: After learning of Fu Yunxi's deception, Zhuang Hanyan was furious and decided to leave the capital with her mother.

Episodes.Title: Accepted the Proposal
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan understood Fu Yunxi's difficulties and decided to marry him. The two vowed to uncover Zhuang Shiyang's true identity.

Episodes.Title: Suffering from Attacks
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan is not welcomed in the Fu's Residence, and is subject to attacks and rumors.

Episodes.Title: Strive for Happiness
Episodes.Description: Fu Yunxi and Zhuang Hanyan discovered that Deng Chan was in love with a poor scholar Cheng Lei, but Deng Chan was already engaged to another man. Fu Yunxi and Zhuang Hanyan noticed something is hidden behind their love.

Episodes.Title: Saving Yao Wangshu
Episodes.Description: In order to gain Official Yao's trust, Zhuang Hanyan decided to help rescue his daughter Yao Wangshu.

Episodes.Title: Threaten to Die
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan asked for Noble Consort Miao's help to remove the heavy military protection for Zhuang Shiyang. She pointed a hairpin towards Noble Consort Miao and threatened her to make a promise.

Episodes.Title: Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan realized Zhuang Shiyang's conspiracy and decided to enter the Palace alone to break the situation. She secretly left a divorce letter to protect the Fu family.

Episodes.Title: Zhuang Family's Birthday Banquet
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan wanted to find out the secret of Zhuang Shiyang's mistake from her grandmother, Wei. So she returned to the Zhuang Residence to attend Wei's birthday banquet.

Episodes.Title: Recognize the Reality
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Shiyang sold Zhou Ruyin to a slave trader. On the road, Zhou Ruyin met a killer sent by Zhuang Shiyang, and Zhuang Hanyan rushed to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Fu Yunxi's Secret
Episodes.Description: Fu Yunxi was poisoned and in a critical condition. He revealed his secret to Zhuang Hanyan, and told her to give up on saving him.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: The culprit who poisoned Fu Yunxi was indeed Zhuang Shiyang. Zhuang Shiyang threatened Fu Yunxi with the prescription and asked him to spare his life.

Episodes.Title: The Truth Revealed
Episodes.Description: Fu Yunxi insisted on entering the Palace to expose the truth. Zhuang Hanyan rushed back to the capital to stop him, but was chased by Duke Qi's men on the way.

Episodes.Title: A Warm Home
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Hanyan successfully prepared an antidote based on the prescription provided by Zhuang Shiyang. Fu Yunxi's condition became stable, but the toxin could not be eradicated.

Entries.Title: Perfect Match
Entries.Description: Newly arrived in Bianjing, Madam Li is turned away by her own daughter. Kangning helps Fuhui teach Fan Lianghan a bitter lesson.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Newly arrived in Bianjing, Madam Li is turned away by her own daughter. Kangning helps Fuhui teach Fan Lianghan a bitter lesson.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Sifu Teahouse opens its doors but immediately faces a slew of challenges. To Fan Lianghan's surprise, Fuhui agrees to let him take a concubine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A costly instrument sparks a race of wits between Kangning and Chai An. On the day of the Mid-Autumn Festival, chaos erupts in front of Sifu Teahouse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Kangning hosts a reconciliation banquet to appease Yang Xian's fury. Upon learning that someone might have a crush on her, Qiongnu makes a risky move.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To clear his name, Chai An vows to hold Liang Junging accountable. At a night market, two Li daughters fall into the hands of a group of outlaws.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Stunned by her son's choice of bride, Chai An's mother treats her prospective in-law with disdain. Kangning makes a tough decision to protect her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As an imperial exam approaches, Sifu House hosts a literary contest with a special prize, but an unexpected guest causes turmoil.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Du Yangxi grows closer to the Li family. Fan Lianghan tries to pair Liu Baniang with Chai An, who agrees to the meeting but has a different plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A conversation with Shouhua leaves Kangning to reflect on her feelings. Later, she discovers a token that reminds her of someone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Swallowing her pride, Madam Chai seeks a way to welcome Kangning back into her family. Shortly after, Chai An is forced into a wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Despite his success with the imperial exam, Du Yangxi finds disappointment in his new marriage. But Shouhua's kindness drives him to make amends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As mounting clues lead Du Yangxi to question his wife's loyalty, Shouhua takes action to investigate who is sabotaging her marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: While Du Yangxi is stunned by a shocking decision from Shouhua, an unsavory rumor rapidly spreads across Bianjing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Shouhua arranges another test to gauge Du Yangxi's commitment. Meanwhile, the opening of a new restaurant threatens business at Sifu House.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Madam Li answers a late-night plea for help from the Cui family. Soon after, the Li family argues over how to handle a growing crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: At an event hosted by the powerful Yu family, Shouhua confronts Yu Xiu'e about her hidden agenda. Du Yangxi's mother faces an uncomfortable dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Sang Yanrang shares a tragic story from his past. After Du Yangxi misses a celebratory dinner, the rift widens between him and the Li family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Despite Shouhua's kindness, Du Yangxi chooses to move forward with the divorce. Yu Xiu'e's wedding takes an unexpected turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: As Du Yangxi's family drama lands him in jail and causes a stir across the city, Shouhua asserts that only one person can save his life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: A self-proclaimed family member files a lawsuit against Madam Li. Later, Haode opens up to Shouhua about her choice of suitor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Forced to share one night together, Haode tries to maintain distance from Shen Huizhao. Chai An unwittingly becomes a prime suspect in a heinous crime.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Haode and Madam Li must face several condescending members of the Shen family. Leshan notices something peculiar about Guiniang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Haode gathers her sisters to strategize and help Guiniang. Soon after, an encounter with a prisoner leads her to suspect a miscarriage of justice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: With Haode's encouragement, Su'e discloses her abuser's ties to a prominent family. A casual chat accidentally reveals hints about Leshan's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Haode's interest in Qiao Du leaves Shen Huizhao feeling jealous. The Shen family's trip to a secluded retreat turns dark.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: A relative of the Shen family shows up with a shocking request. Haode uses her wit to help Shen Huizhao adjudicate a tricky case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Haode finds Yuchan a suitor who meets her standards, but an unexpected incident turns her wedding day into a nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Shen Huizhao must confront a series of damaging allegations. Madam Li considers a promising match for her youngest daughter, Leshan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: While the Li family scrambles to fix a major mix-up at Leshan's wedding, the Yangs must cope with the fiery new bride joining their household.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: At the Li residence, Yang Xian tries to make amends with the family, but he and Leshan find it difficult to maintain the facade of a loving couple.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: In the wake of a mysterious death, Yang Xian must confront a serious accusation. Meanwhile, a rumor about Leshan begins to spread like wildfire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: To prove his devotion to Leshan, Yang Xian agrees to undergo three tests. Soon after, a lion dance contest suddenly takes a perilous turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Leshan challenges Yang Xian to find the owner of a lost handkerchief — a test that triggers a series of repercussions within the Yang family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Caught in a family crisis, Yang Xian must start a business to pass his final test. Leshan faces mounting pressure to end their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Madam Li's efforts to find Leshan a husband land on someone from a distinguished family. An unexpected reunion leaves the Li family reeling with emotion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: She Cong and Yang Xian strive to hold Cui Weizhi and Jiang Chaozong accountable. As the dust settles, the Li family embraces a wave of joyful events.

Entries.Title: When Destiny Brings the Demon
Entries.Description: Immortal Sima Jiao forms a bond with his mysterious new assistant Liao Tingyan. As they grow closer, he tries to find out more about her.

Episodes.Title: An Unbothered Player in the Survival Game
Episodes.Description: Immortal Sima Jiao forms a bond with his mysterious new assistant Liao Tingyan. As they grow closer, he tries to find out more about her.

Episodes.Title: Struck by an NPC's Fate, but Can't Go AFK
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao allows Liao Tingyan to stay with him after learning her true identity, but her strange responses while under a spell add to the intrigue.

Episodes.Title: Don't Try to Understand Madness. Lay Low and Live Another Day
Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan finds an ally and questions her relationship with Sima Jiao. Meanwhile, Sima Jiao tries to break his seal but suffers harmful consequences.

Episodes.Title: The True Meaning Behind "Kill Me" is Way Too Scary
Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan grows closer to Sima Jiao after learning of his imprisonment. An Xue plots against Liao Tingyan after overhearing a piece of information.

Episodes.Title: The Key Player and Survivorin the Grandmaster's Revenge Plan
Episodes.Description: After Sima Jiao injures himself, the mountain comes under attack. Liao Tingyan falls into trouble and Ye Ruling's identity is revealed.

Episodes.Title: I Got Wind of Grandmaster's Most Guarded Secret. What to Do Now?
Episodes.Description: The palaces arrange a marriage between Sima E and Sima Shi. Liao Tingyan decides to stay with Sima Jiao, who doesn't realize he is falling for her.

Episodes.Title: He'd Only Ever Killed. The Few He Saved Were for Her
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao brings Liao Tingyan to a banquet, which descends into conflict. Shi Qianlu tries to reseal Sima Jiao and misses an important appointment.

Episodes.Title: It Turns Out That I'm a Player Who Cannot Remain Uninvolved
Episodes.Description: Hei Nianjiu pledges allegiance to Ye Ruling, while Master Zhenxu plots to frame Sima Jiao. As alliances shift, Liao Tingyan becomes bait in a trap.

Episodes.Title: Glitched into an In-Game Odyssey of Cultivation Trials and Tribulations
Episodes.Description: Ye Ruling tries to warn Liao Tingyan, but Sima Jiao steps in. Shi Qianlu sends Shi Zhenxu to Chiyan City — Sima Jiao's next destination.

Episodes.Title: A Disguised Inspection with Grandmaster is Always a Disaster
Episodes.Description: After his bloodline awakens, Sima Jiao changes form to learn about his birthmark. Meanwhile, Ye Ruling meets Liao Tingyan at the Yan residence.

Episodes.Title: Feels Like a Love-Struck Girl
Episodes.Description: A disguised Sima Jiao stirs trouble in the Yan home while Liao Tingyan pushes him to reveal his feelings. Master Yan reveals his ancient ties.

Episodes.Title: The Real Battle is Inside the Mean Grandmaster's Home
Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan comforts Sima Jiao when a tragedy triggers memories of his past. Shi Qianlu attempts to frame Sima Jiao.

Episodes.Title: She is the Last Breath of Hope for the Grandmaster?
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao and Liao Tingyan escape captivity into a spiritual realm. Shi Qianlu spreads lies, fueling Shi Zhenxu's hatred toward Sima Jiao.

Episodes.Title: A Role-Play Game Amidst Peril
Episodes.Description: Ye Ruling allies with Shi Qianlu. Liao Tingyan and Sima Jiao take an important step to evade hunters and put their plan in motion.

Episodes.Title: Love Takes Two to Tango
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao gives Liao Tinyang a gift to help them communicate when they're apart from each other. Shi Qianlu's people try to catch Hei Nianjiu.

Episodes.Title: Long-Distance Relationships are Bound to Have Many Uncertainties
Episodes.Description: When Liao Tingyan faces danger, Ye Ruling reports the incident to Shi Qianlu. Sima Jiao rushes to the rescue and forms a plan to confuse their enemies.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Fights Lightning with His Bare Hands is the Ultimate Catch
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao helps Liao Tingyan recover, and their deepening relationship produces a surprising outcome. However, danger awaits in Fenghua City.

Episodes.Title: No Quest is Harder Than Love
Episodes.Description: Shi Qianlu tries to trap Sima Jiao but the plan backfires with deadly consequences. Sima Jiao pushes Liao Tingyan past her limits, leaving her in shock.

Episodes.Title: Immortals and Demons are Worlds Apart, Separated by Life and Death
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao learns the truth about his family at Taiwei Mountain. Shi Qianlu tries to use Liao Tingyan as bait, but she vanishes as the plan unfolds.

Episodes.Title: Given the Average Lifespan in This World, It's Only a Brief Parting
Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan seeks a peaceful life after Shi Qianlu erases her memory and gives her a new identity. Sima Jiao desperately searches for her.

Episodes.Title: Shi Qianlv, the Stock You Bought Tanked
Episodes.Description: In Hexian City, Shi Yan learns that Sima Jiao is the attacker. Shi Qianlu urges her to seek revenge, but Hei Nianjiu has other plans.

Episodes.Title: What's Your Lover Liao Tingyan Got to Do with Me, Shi Yan?
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao tries to bond with Shi Yan, but her doubts about her true identity hold her back. Hei Nianjiu's search for Shi Qianlu unearths a surprise.

Episodes.Title: If We Still Have Faith in Love, Memory Loss Just Here to Spice Things Up
Episodes.Description: Hei Nianjiu shares what he's learned. A jealous Sima Jiao revisits the past with Shi Yan to soften her heart and revive her memory.

Episodes.Title: Was It Really Me? The Girl Who Valiantly Dated Big Boss Back Then?
Episodes.Description: Seeking the truth about her identity, Shi Yan tries to escape. Sima Jiao helps her, with unexpected results. A plot to kill Sima Jiao begins to brew.

Episodes.Title: Traveling Together on Vacation is the Perfect Chance to Grow Closer
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao and Liao Tingyan reunite and grow closer than ever. Believing Sima Jiao has wronged him, Feng Qi conspires to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: This is Some Dangerous Romance
Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan feels a chill when she kisses Sima Jiao, alerting them to danger. Shi Qianlu tricks Liao Tingyan into removing her bracelet.

Episodes.Title: Now I Am Strong Enough to Fight Lightning Too
Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan helps Sima Jiao and Hei Nianjiu escape before falling into an abyss. Recovering her memories and powers, she claims a new identity.

Episodes.Title: Will It Only Be Happiness From Here On?
Episodes.Description: Feng Qi offers to help Liao Tingyan. However, when renewed conflict breaks out, he reveals his ulterior motives and puts a sinister plan into action.

Episodes.Title: If the Harsh Winter Comes, He'll Leave Me a Fire
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao's loss leaves a devastated and heartbroken Liao Tingyan behind. Nineteen years later, he is reborn with no memory of his past.

Episodes.Title: The Villain in the Story May Be Late, but Will Surely Arrive
Episodes.Description: Sima Jiao grows close to Liao Tingyan but doubts her motives. When she reacts strangely to an injury during an assassination attempt, the mystery grows.

Episodes.Title: The More We Keep Secrets, the More We Look Like a Couple
