Episodes.Description: Liao Tingyan reveals the truth about their bond to a skeptical Sima Jiao. Together with Hong Luo, she tries to learn more about a dangerous plot.

Episodes.Title: What I Gave You Is Yours to Do With as You Will
I Want You to Stay, I Will Find You

Entries.Title: The Prisoner of Beauty
Entries.Description: Fourteen years after a feud was sparked, the Qiao and Wei families become united when Xiao Qiao is sent to marry Wei Shao in her sister's place.

Episodes.Title: Feud
Episodes.Description: Fourteen years after a feud was sparked, the Qiao and Wei families become united when Xiao Qiao is sent to marry Wei Shao in her sister's place.

Episodes.Title: Betrothal
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao's marriage talks end poorly. Misunderstood by the people of Xindu, Wei Shao gains some support thanks to Xiao Qiao's help.

Episodes.Title: Expelled
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao sends Xiao Qiao away from Xindu after gaining the seal. Xiao Qiao vows to stop Liu Yan's evil plan. Wei Shao attacks Panyi.

Episodes.Title: Prejudices
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao is torn between Wei Shao and Liu Yan. She mourns her grandfather but, out of duty, she vows to honor her engagement.

Episodes.Title: The Marriage
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao attends his family's memorial, leaving the injured Xiao Qiao outside the city. She feigns weakness, stirring his guilt.

Episodes.Title: A Loving Couple
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao struggles with her mother-in-law. Elders urge Wei Shao to take a concubine — though seemingly loving, he is wary of the Qiao family.

Episodes.Title: Pay Back
Episodes.Description: Charmed by Wei Shao's affection, Xiao Qiao begins to fall for him. Lady Zhu hopes he'll take Zheng Chuyu as a concubine. Xiao Qiao is framed.

Episodes.Title: Secret Planning
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao secretly helps Bi Zhi become commander of Boya. Under Gongsun Yang's guidance, Wei Shao learns how to behave toward his wife.

Episodes.Title: Showdown
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao learns he's been used, straining his bond with Xiao Qiao. Lady Xu warns Xiao Qiao, who uncovers Wei Shao's weakness.

Episodes.Title: Lingering Fear
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao defends a targeted Wei Shao, deepening their bond. Wei Shao asks Xiao Qiao to organize Lady Xu's birthday banquet.

Episodes.Title: A Birthday Gift
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao faces setbacks while putting together a gift for Lady Xu. Provoked by Wei Yan, Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao have a terrible fight.

Episodes.Title: Instigate
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao urges Wei Shao to divert water from Yanzhou to relieve the drought. Wei Yan's revelations about Wei Shao lead Xiao Qiao to feel betrayed.

Episodes.Title: Sulking
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao agrees to repair the canal to smooth his relationship with Xiao Qiao. Lady Su E Huang arrives for a visit — but she has an ulterior motives.

Episodes.Title: Lady Yulou's Visit
Episodes.Description: Su E Huang meets Wei Shao alone, upsetting Xiao Qiao. Grain sent by the Qiao family is destroyed — and Xiao Qiao and Wei Yan are blamed.

Episodes.Title: Find the Culprit
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao prompts Wei Yan to reconcile with his grandmother, then takes action to resolve the conflict between Lady Zhu and Wei Shao.

Episodes.Title: Mediate
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao and Xiao Qiao grow closer when they travel to Rong County. A conspiracy against Wei Shao begins to unfold.

Episodes.Title: Probing
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao faces trouble. Xiao Qiao helps him rally the troops. After Yuan Wang and Wei Dian oppose the canal plan, Xiao Qiao plots to drive them apart.

Episodes.Title: Stargazing Date
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao tries to deepen her bond with Wei Shao. Yuan Wang's daughter falls for Wei Liang, unaware that his heart belongs to another.

Episodes.Title: Real Feelings
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao and his party return to Yu County, but Xiao Qiao has an accident. After the scare, they finally open their hearts to each other.

Episodes.Title: Truly Cares
Episodes.Description: Da Qiao and her husband live peacefully. As Wei Shao's relationship with his mother improves, his feelings for Xiao Qiao are confirmed.

Episodes.Title: Live Without Her
Episodes.Description: After avoiding Xiao Qiao for a while, Wei Shao resolves to reconcile with his feelings, which leads their relationship to deepen.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Wei Yan hides his feelings for Xiao Qiao. Xiao Qiao and Wei Shao attend a New Year ceremony together, and grow closer.

Episodes.Title: Heart-guarding Mirror
Episodes.Description: Da Qiao helps Bi Zhi bolster his position. An ill-intentioned Su E Huang shows up. Liu Yan prepares to make his move at the upcoming assembly.

Episodes.Title: The Deer Hunt
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao welcomes Qiao Ci, then exposes Su E Huang. On the day of the assembly, Qiao Ci and Su Zi Xin confront each other.

Episodes.Title: Change of Reputation
Episodes.Description: A successful Qiao Ci helps Wei Shao with the canal project. Wei Shao and Xiao Qiao open up to each other. Su E Huang tries to win over Liu Yan.

Episodes.Title: Seducing Wei Shao
Episodes.Description: Su E Huang fails to seduce Wei Shao. Gao Heng leaves Yu County. Su E Huang discovers Wei Yan’s feelings for Xiao Qiao.

Episodes.Title: Spreading Rumours
Episodes.Description: A jealous Wei Shao quarrels with Xiao Qiao before making up. To protect them, Wei Yan decides to reveal what really happened.

Episodes.Title: Telling the Truth
Episodes.Description: Wei Yan leaves Yu County. Punished and exiled, Su E Huang vows revenge. Liu Yan leads his troops to war on behalf of Su E Huang.

Episodes.Title: Attacking Yanzhou
Episodes.Description: Liu Yan leads his troops on the offensive. Wei Shao faces a dilemma. Xiao Qiao seeks help. Wei Yan attempts to support Wei Shao.

Episodes.Title: Heartbroken
Episodes.Description: Xiao Qiao risks her life to join Wei Shao and successfully persuades the enemy forces to retreat. Liu Yan withdraws.

Episodes.Title: Knelt down
Episodes.Description: After a misunderstanding, Wei Shao rushes after Xiao Qiao. Da Qiao and her husband decide to return to Kang County. Wei Shao opens up to Xiao Qiao.

Episodes.Title: Knelt Down
Episodes.Description: Liu Yan decides to pursue the traitor. The Qiao family reunites. Wei Shao makes overtures to Xiao Qiao's family, and to include her in his.

Episodes.Title: Good Luck
Episodes.Description: Su E Huang does what it takes to motivate Liu Yan. Xiao Qiao surprises Wei Shao. Wei Liang heads to Kang County.

Episodes.Title: Sever All Ties
Episodes.Description: Qiao Ping is trapped. Da Qiao is in danger. Wei Liang dies in a battle. Wei Shao vows revenge.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Outcome
Episodes.Description: Wei Shao leads his troops into battle. Su E Huang claims a victory. Qiao Ping is rescued and sends reinforcements to Wei Shao.

Episodes.Title: At War
Episodes.Description: Wei Yan shows up at a critical moment. Bi Zhi and Wei Shao join forces for a siege. Liu Yan is defeated. Peace is achieved at last.

Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Female Lead
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Six Months before the Wedding
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: Love Line
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: Stalling Tactic
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: Law of Mutual Rescue
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: Assassin
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: Playing Along
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: Two Li Shi Liu
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has Their Own Agenda
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Wish
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: Fire in the Southern District
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: Once Friends
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: Cracking the Secret Symbol
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Public Proposal
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: Expressing One's Feelings
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: Immortal under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Granted Marriage
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: Changing Fate
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Concubine
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Offense and Defense
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: Last Farewell
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Do-Or-Die Plan
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Identity Revealed
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: Atone with His Life
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: Let Go of Yourself
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Can Be Changed
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: Forced to Extremes
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: World in a Storybook
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: The Vow
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: The Scripted World
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: In a Different Light
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: Infinity Loop
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Launching a Pre-emptive Strike
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Tide
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.

Entries.Title: Ski into Love
Entries.Description: Dan Chong helps his sister, Dan Shan, to buy a 2nd-hand drawing tablet online. He and the seller arrange to meet at Nancheng's Anime Carnival for the trade. Wu Man Man replaces Wi Zhi as Azhai for the book-signing event held there. Dan Chong helps his sister to acquire the signature of Azhai. He accidentally finds out that the seller of the drawing tablet is actually Wei Zhi, whom he met at the subway by coincidence.

Episodes.Title: Desire to Create
Episodes.Description: Dan Chong helps his sister, Dan Shan, to buy a 2nd-hand drawing tablet online. He and the seller arrange to meet at Nancheng's Anime Carnival for the trade. Wu Man Man replaces Wi Zhi as Azhai for the book-signing event held there. Dan Chong helps his sister to acquire the signature of Azhai. He accidentally finds out that the seller of the drawing tablet is actually Wei Zhi, whom he met at the subway by coincidence.

Episodes.Title: Snowboarding Pro
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi meets the main character of the snowboarding promotional video who made her heart flutter at the convention. She also becomes elated after receiving a piece of goggle cloth from him. However, Wei Zhi doesn't realize that the pro is Shan Chong.

Episodes.Title: Her Own Story
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi sits alone by the slopes and watches the video of Shan Chong and Dai Duo to search for inspiration for her work. Wei Zhi begins to fall in love with snowboarding.

Episodes.Title: Joining the Comic Contest
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi finds out about the original snow sports comic drawing contest. She decides to join it. She invites Shan Chong to join her as a character in her comic.

Episodes.Title: Battle
Episodes.Description: Yan and Bei Ci go to Wantong Academy to argue with K. Shan Chong agrees to face K at the terrain park in a tricks battle.

Episodes.Title: The Real Him
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi meets up with Shan Shan. She is shocked when she finds out that Shan Chong is her older brother.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Wang Xin, Shan Chong's snowboarding coach, tries to persuade him to return to the national team, causing them to think about his retirement after getting injured five years ago.

Episodes.Title: Pursuing Dreams
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi wants to continue her career in comics. So, she musters up her courage to find Da Xiang and invite Da Xiang to join her studio.

Episodes.Title: Return to Xicheng
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi pleads with her mother to let her go to Xicheng Ski Resort for research, but Mrs. Wei urges her to give up her comic career and marry Jiang Yi Ming as soon as possible.

Episodes.Title: Love Rivals
Episodes.Description: Jiang Nan Feng wants to find Wei Zhi at Xicheng. When Wei Zhi goes to the airport to pick her up, she finds out that Jiang Yi Ming has come to Xicheng together with his sister.

Episodes.Title: Heartfelt Conversations
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong sends a drunk Wei Zhi back to the hotel. Both of them have a heartfelt conversation in the hotel room. Shan Chong asks Wei Zhi about her relationship with Jiang Yi Ming.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Gem
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi, Shan Chong, and the group travel to Lezhou. After dinner, Yan and Bei Ci ask Jiang Yi Ming about his relationship with Wei Zhi. After overhearing their conversation, Shan Chong goes to find Wei Zhi and tells her he wants to take her to a place.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong tells Wei Zhi his story. At night, both of them squeeze into a sleeping bag intimately.

Episodes.Title: Promise of Return
Episodes.Description: The coach invites Shan Chong to return to the national team again. Shan Chong agrees to it. He states that he'll return to the team once he saves enough money to buy Shan Shan a pair of prosthetics.

Episodes.Title: Visiting the Shan Family
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong brings Wei Zhi home to see his parents. He tells them his plan to get prosthetic limbs fitted for Shan Shan, and that the attending physician, Jiang Yi Ming, is Wei Zhi's childhood friend. Shan Chong's parents express their gratitude to Wei Zhi.

Episodes.Title: Exposed Relationship
Episodes.Description: Dai Duo sends Shan Shan home but both are reluctant to say goodbye to each other. Their relationship is exposed when Wei Zhi and Shan Chong catch them kissing.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Up
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi's mother belittles Shan Chong with her words. Shan Chong thinks that he cannot provide Wei Zhi with a dependable future as of yet. He breaks up with Wei Zhi.

Episodes.Title: Perseverance and Courage
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi meets with Wu Man Man and asks her whether she is facing creative burnout and pressure from Wang Lao Hu. Drawing from her own experiences, Wei Zhi encourages Wu Man Man.

Episodes.Title: Rewrite the Ending
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi invites Wu Man Man to the studio. Everyone gathers at Wei Zhi's studio to complete the finale of Farewell Song together.

Episodes.Title: Returning to the National Team
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong tells his parents that he has decided to return to the national team. His parents support his decision.

Episodes.Title: A Long-Awaited Reunion
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi travels to Xicheng for an inspiration searching trip, with the first stop being a visit to the national snowboarding training center. She sees Shan Chong again after a long time apart.

Episodes.Title: Deemed Worthy
Episodes.Description: Wei Zhi reconciles with Shan Chong. They decide to split up and persuade Wei Zhi's father and mother respectively to agree to their relationship.

Episodes.Title: A Promised Future
Episodes.Description: Shan Chong and Dai Duo reach the finals in the Men's Snowboard Big Air event. Wei Zhi and the gang go there to support them.

Episodes.Title: Posing as Marquis Pingjin
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai seeks Xiang An Tu's help to get rid of Lu Jin. Xiang An Tu arranges assassins along Lu Jin's route back to the capital.

Episodes.Title: Hungry Ghost Festival
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai resolves the crisis successfully and crafts a camellia hairpin to thank Xiang An Tu. Xiang An Tu invites Zang Hai to watch the lights and have a chat during the Hungry Ghost Festival.

Episodes.Title: The Other Man
Episodes.Description: Zhongzhou is flooded. Chu Huai Ming tries to set a fire to murder Zang Hai before trouble arises. Zhuang Zhi Xing, who has received instructions from Zang Hai beforehand, apprehends him.

Episodes.Title: Treasure of Dongxia
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai learns about Zhuang Lu Yin and Shen Wan's past from Gao Ming. He helps Zhuang Lu Yin deal with his guilt and advises him to nurture Zhuang Zhi Xing while gaining more of his trust at the same time.

Episodes.Title: Resolve for Vengeance
Episodes.Description: After assuming office, Zang Hai finds out that officials of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau have been arranging posthumous marriage, sometimes even at the cost of innocent lives. He drafts a decree overnight and swiftly begins cracking down on corruption to purge the bureau of its rot.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Zhi Xing heeds Zang Hai's suggestion. He joins the military but is put on the spot on multiple occasions. He intends to become a deserter.

Episodes.Title: Approaching Yong Rong
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai receives an invite to Yong Rong's banquet at Zhen Tower. Someone mentions Kuai Duo at the banquet. Zang Hai quietly probes Yong Rong.

Episodes.Title: Investigation at the Zhao Residence
Episodes.Description: At the banquet, several officials talk about Minister of Revenue Zhao Bing Wen. Their words spark Zang Hai's suspicion. He decides to visit the Zhao Residence and search the place in secret.

Episodes.Title: Owning up to One's Wrongdoing
Episodes.Description: Cao Jing Xian forces Zang Hai to complete the general's burial mound before the Double Ninth Festival. Zang Hai has no choice but to use Zhuang Zhi Fu to resolve his issue. When Zhuang Lu Yin finds out, he questions him. Unexpectedly, Zang Hai owns up to his wrongdoings.

Episodes.Title: A Trap to Sow Discord
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai sets up a trap to sow discord between Zhuang Lu Yin and Cao Jing Xian. He follows Cao Jing Xian and finds out that he is secretly meeting the hostage of Dongxia. Zang Hai is sure that the third person will appear soon.

Episodes.Title: Chaos at the Marquis' Residence
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Lu Yin covertly plans to impeach Cao Jing Xian but ends up being framed instead. Just as he falls into peril, Zhuang Zhi Xing, acting on Zang Hai's prior instructions, leads reinforcements and arrives in time to save the day.

Episodes.Title: Doubts
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai suspects that Xiang An Tu is his enemy upon finding out that she's the nation's hostage. Xiang An Tu denies his claim, yet she finds it difficult to explain the relationship between Dongxia and Cao Jing Xian.

Episodes.Title: Truth of the Annihilation
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Luyin tells Zhuang Zhixing the truth of the Kuai family's annihilation. Zhuang Zhixing gives Zang Hai the bronze fish piece he obtained from his father and tells Zang Hai the identity of the third person.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Luyin attempts to seek a truce with Cao Jingxian, but the blood-written letter he sends is swapped by Zang Hai. Deceived by its contents, Cao Jingxian tricks Zhuang Luyin's former subordinates into launching a prison break.

Episodes.Title: Father and Son Duel
Episodes.Description: Zhuang Zhixing advises his father to give up on capturing the city and both of them begin a duel.

Episodes.Title: Empress of Dongxia
Episodes.Description: The Empress of Dongxia offers a wooden palace to the capital as tribute. Zang Hai thinks the wooden palace is made with his father's technique.

Episodes.Title: The Empress and Kuai Duo
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai lures the Empress into an empty tomb, while Xiang Antu escapes from the Zang Residence, determined to stop him from killing her mother.

Episodes.Title: Choice
Episodes.Description: The Empress tells Zang Hai about the history of the Gui Seal. She forces him to make a choice between the Gui Seal and her daughter.

Episodes.Title: Gui Seal
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai finally finds the Gui Seal. While he is focusing on carving the patterns on the forged Gui Seal, the Gui Seal is taken away by Cao Jingxian's foster son.

Episodes.Title: The Buried Past
Episodes.Description: Suspecting that Xiang Antu has stolen the Gui Seal, the Emperor orders the Hostage's Mansion to be surrounded.

Episodes.Title: Mysterious Figure
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai finds out that the third culprit has resurfaced. The Emperor orders him to investigate the third culprit and the location of the Gui Seal.

Episodes.Title: The Revenge Plan
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai obtains a new clue thanks to a mysterious person's help. Zang Hai finds the Gui Seal in the Shi Residence and hands it over to the Emperor.

Episodes.Title: Intersecting Leads
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai finds out that Cao Jingxian's original name was Lu Min before he joined the palace. All the leads intersect with each other. Zang Hai finds out the true identity of the third culprit.

Episodes.Title: The Third Person Appears
Episodes.Description: Zang Hai is captured by the Imperial Guards. When the Emperor questions him, he reminds the Emperor to be wary of the third person...

Episodes.Title: Execution
Episodes.Description: The third perpetrator agrees to grant Zang Hai a dignified death. The executioner layers sheets of wet paper over Zang Hai's face, until his pulse fades completely.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Prison
Episodes.Description: Xiang Antu asks to meet Zang Hai one last time. Both of them use a code to set up a trap and plan for the escape.

Episodes.Title: Last Clash
Episodes.Description: The third perpetrator barges into the sacred ground of Dongxia. He forces Zang Hai to consume the Gui Seal poison, coercing him into teaching him how to control the undead soldiers.

Episodes.Title: A Duel on the Business Field

Entries.Title: Moonlit Reunion
Entries.Description: Cat Lord Wu Zhen traps a demon while Mei Zhuyu exposes his priesthood—their paths cross again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Cat Lord Wu Zhen traps a demon while Mei Zhuyu exposes his priesthood—their paths cross again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Wu Zhen seizes the Female Bat and learns its loss of sanity is tied to the cursed Bone Relic.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: At the banquet, Mei and Wu expose Xie Loubai's lantern trick, trapping the Shadow Demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Discovering the Bone Relic in Mei Zhuyu's possession, Wu Zhen prepares to steal it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Wu fails to break the bone. Elder Hui colludes with Shan Posuo; Wu and Mei search the Hills.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ling Xiao and Wu Zi Shu expose Elder Hui's plot, while Mei Zhuyu and Wu Zi Shu destroy Shan Posuo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Mei Zhuyu returns to petition for the Bureau Chief position. Hu Zhu tests Shuang Jiang's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Hu Zhu and Shuang Jiang confront a demon while Mei and Wu Zhen discover odd camellias in the palace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Mei and Wu investigate a case of spirit-princess while Elder Hui conspires with Xuan Hui.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Xuan Hui attacks the city. Mei is injured protecting Wu Zhen. Liu defeats the demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Wu Zhen confirms Xuan Hui's attack and heals Mei Zhuyu. Mei gradually develops feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Wu Zhen defeats Elder Hui in the Demon Underworld by using Cat Lord powers in the mortal duel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Wu Zhen repairs the Demon Underworld's barrier, unknowingly clashing with Mei in disguise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Mei moves out of the Wu residence, encounters bandits, and falls victim to Pei Jiya's poisoning.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Mei stays in Chang'an to investigate Pei while Wu Zhen joins the Scented Duel with others.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Anbilo kills for incense. Mei's rescue of Wu Zhen reveals his secret abilities, making Pei doubt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Mei Si accidentally summons ink demons that Mei Zhuyu destroys, while Wu Zhen discovers Xuan Hui.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: When Pei Jiya proposes to Wu Zhen, Mei becomes suspicious and discovers his dark practices.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: At Lin'an River, Pei's exposed identity traps Wu Zhen and Mei Zhuyu in a deadly choice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Mei Zhu Yu and Wu Zhen are caught in the formation. After confessing his love to Wu Zhen, Mei Zhu Yu pushes her out of the stalagmite formation, while he plummets to the depth below.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Wu Zi Shu knocks out Wu Zhen with a spell and brings her back to the Demon City. He asks Wu Zhen why she fell in love with a mortal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Chang Ming wants to appoint Mei Zhu Yu as the Head Administrator of the sect. Mei Zhu Yu declines his offer. He intends to leave the sect and get married. The other sect members are dumbfounded.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Under Chang Ming's request, Mei Zhu Yu leaves behind the Changxi Truncheon. He leaves the sect after that. Meanwhile, Wu Zhen is absent-minded due to Mei Zhu Yu's long absence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Mei Zhu Yu and Wu Zhen are finally married. On their wedding day, guests gather to witness the ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: When the dream demon invades Ling Xiao's dream, Wu Zhen catches it red-handed. The demon isn't willing to return to the Demon City with Wu Zhen. Thus, it causes her to have a dream within a dream.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: At night, Wu Zhen detects that something's off about her body. She sneaks out of the Mei Residence to find Wu Zi Shu. Wu Zi Shu tells her that he has a way to turn her into a full demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Liu Tai Zhen tells Wu Zhen that the Skin Shop is preparing a skin for her. Wu Zhen finds out that the price to pay for becoming a complete demon is to give up on her original body and cultivate in seclusion for 50 years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Wu Zi Shu encourages Hu Zhu to find Shuang Jiang to verify his identity, intentionally leading her into the hands of Chang Ming and his fellow exorcists. Chang Ming strikes Hu Zhu off a cliff. Shuang Jiang leaps down after her.

Episodes.Title: The Core of Sinister Fiend
Episodes.Description: Under the pretence of catching a cheating spouse, Wu Zhen claims that Mei Zhu Yu is her husband. The two put on an act for Chang Ming Lian Fu. Chang Ming then reveals that the Divine Fire from 18 years ago was caused by the Demon City, and tells Mei Zhu Yu that he should avenge his parents.

Episodes.Title: Divorce
Episodes.Description: Wu Zhen asks Wu Zi Shu if he knew that Mei Zhu Yu was related to Changxi Palace long ago. Wu Zi Shu confesses. Mei Zhu Yu returns to the Mei Residence. Everything has changed. He doesn't know what to do.

Episodes.Title: Mortal Body
Episodes.Description: Liu Tai Zhen is in a hurry to get her body back. Thus, she frequents the Mei Residence to seek Mei Zhu Yu's help. The public witnesses her visits. They gossip about the relationship between her and Mei Zhu Yu. Wu Chun Dao and Liu Gong Shen head to the Mei Residence to investigate the affair. They see their intimate behavior. Liu Gong Shen faints out of spite.

Episodes.Title: Life-and-Death Crisis
Episodes.Description: Wu Zi Shu is shoved aside by Mei Zhu Yu. Wu Zhen uses her last bit of conscience to suppress the core inside her body. Wu Zi Shu wants to check on Wu Zhen but Mei Zhu Yu stops him and blames Wu Zi Shu for almost killing Wu Zhen.

Episodes.Title: Zhuyu Divine Herb
Episodes.Description: Wu Zhen and Mei Zhu Yu try to inquire about the location of the Zhuyu Divine Herb. They come across a mysterious residence. The guests meet Physician Gu one by one, hoping to fulfill their wishes.

Entries.Title: The Real Daughter of the Countryside Is the Ancestor
Summit of Our Youth
Entries.Description: In 2024, when Gu Xue Jiao, a graduate from a non-prestigious university, fails to land a high-level position, she confronts CEO Lin Zhi Hua. The two get into a heated argument as the lift suddenly plummets. When she wakes up, her life has restarted, and she is back at 18.

Episodes.Title: Back at 18
Episodes.Description: In 2024, when Gu Xue Jiao, a graduate from a non-prestigious university, fails to land a high-level position, she confronts CEO Lin Zhi Hua. The two get into a heated argument as the lift suddenly plummets. When she wakes up, her life has restarted, and she is back at 18.

Episodes.Title: Out-of-print Review Materials
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao tries to convince Lin Zhi Hua to tutor her. Lin Zhi Hua puts together a list of out-of-print review materials that are practically impossible to find and demands that she gather them all before he will tutor her. Gu Xue Jiao accepts the challenge.

Episodes.Title: Avoiding Bankruptcy
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao recalls how Gu Shuo listened to insider information and bought stocks during a parent-teacher meeting in her previous life, leading to the family's bankruptcy. So Gu Xue Jiao decides to hide the parent-teacher meeting from her father and find someone else to take his place.

Episodes.Title: Stand Up for Herself
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao is accused of being responsible for the conflict between the two classes. She stands her ground and cleverly resolves the issue using her previous workplace experience.

Episodes.Title: Rebuilding Confidence
Episodes.Description: Gao Rui wakes up to find Lin Zhi Hua in a completely different state than before. To help Lin Zhi Hua regain his confidence, Gu Xue Jiao goes to great lengths to persuade him to return to his alma mater to give a lecture.

Episodes.Title: Closing the Distance
Episodes.Description: Everyone gathers on the old rooftop of Gu Xue Jiao's house for a party to celebrate her ranking in the top 100. Lin Zhi Hua promises to continue tutoring Gu Xue Jiao until the college entrance exam is over, bringing the two of them closer together.

Episodes.Title: Buying a House
Episodes.Description: The landlord informs Gu Xue Jiao that he's selling the house she and her family lives in. Gu Xue Jiao knows that the house will be demolished the following year and they will receive a large compensation for the demolition, so she suggests that her parents buy the house.

Episodes.Title: Pursuing Dreams
Episodes.Description: Lin Zhi Hua supports Gu Xue Jiao in applying to Jinghai University and takes her to the university laboratory to sort out materials. Gu Xue Jiao becomes more and more determined that Jinghai University is her dream.

Episodes.Title: His Smiles
Episodes.Description: By a sheer twist of fate, Gu Xue Jiao meets Lin Zhi Hua's mom and discovers his unhappy childhood.

Episodes.Title: Trapped in the Mountains
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao gets lost in the mountains, and through roaring wind and pouring rain, Lin Zhi Hua rushes to her rescue.

Episodes.Title: Military Training Camp
Episodes.Description: Lin Zhi Hua tricked Gu Xue Jiao to go downstairs under the pretext of military training, but in fact it was to give her a birthday surprise late at night.

Episodes.Title: Joining the Lab
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao volunteers to fix a computer problem during Professor Tan's class, leaving a deep impression on him. He agrees to let her join the lab.

Episodes.Title: A Farewell Party
Episodes.Description: Lin Zhi Hua is about to head abroad, so the lab holds a farewell party for him. Gu Xue Jiao accepts the invitation to attend.

Episodes.Title: Professing Feelings
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao keeps a social distance from Lin Zhi Hua but she can't help wanting to know what he's doing.

Episodes.Title: Growing Affection
Episodes.Description: Lin Zhi Hua and Gu Xue Jiao team up working on IT. When no one is around, they get all lovey-dovey. Yet, despite being cautious, they nearly get found out.

Episodes.Title: True Colors
Episodes.Description: While Gu Xue Jiao and Lin Zhi Hua are celebrating the signing of the contract, Gao Rui and Lin Zhi Yue show up unexpectedly and changes the atmosphere. Ms. Zheng tricks Lin Zhi Hua and the latter pretends to have given up while contacting other entrepreneurs secretly.

Episodes.Title: Preparing for the Competition
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao signs up for the National Intelligent Security Competition, determined to prove Jinghai University's technological autonomy. The newly formed team consists of outstanding members but lacks unity. While preparing for the face-off, a power outage occurs, and they discover Lin Jia Dong is behind it, sparking a silent war between the two teams.

Episodes.Title: In-house Showdown
Episodes.Description: Before the in-house showdown begins, the source code of Gu Xue Jiao's team gets leaked.

Episodes.Title: Winning Her Back
Episodes.Description: Gu Xue Jiao forces Ms. Zheng to acknowledge Jinghai University's technological achievements. Humiliated and enraged, Ms. Zheng seeks to strip Jinghai University of its championship title. While Lin Zhi Hua struggles with whether to confess his reincarnated identity, Gu Xue Jiao unexpectedly learns of it and begins to harbor doubts.

Episodes.Title: Reborn
Episodes.Description: Lin Jia Dong is suspected of being a spy, but Gu Xue Jiao expresses her trust in him. Lin Zhi Hua signs an agreement with B and C, much to Gu Xue Jiao's surprise. The two of them come clean to each other about their 'reborn' identities and reconcile.

Entries.Title: Legend of the Female General
Entries.Description: He Yan returns home victorious after many years at war. Her father makes an outrageous request. Xiao Jue fails to defend his father's honor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: He Yan returns home victorious after many years at war. Her father makes an outrageous request. Xiao Jue fails to defend his father's honor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Years before achieving glory, He Yan donned a mask to enter Xianchang Academy. Now, she enlists at a garrison — but can she hide that she's a woman?

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After a brief scuffle in the hot springs, He Yan escapes, but not without rousing Xiao Jue's suspicions. He orders Shen Han to spread rumors.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: He Yan receives ointment — the same Xiao Jue once gave her at Xianchang Academy — but she's too focused on joining the elite battalion to notice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Xiao Jue learns Sun Xiangfu is delaying rations and decides to confront the magistrate. During the flag contest, He Yan's team faces Lei Hou's.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Frustrated and upset about not making it into the battalion, He Yan gets drunk, barges into Xiao Jue's tent and causes a ruckus.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: He Yan tails Ding Yi to Wanhua Pavilion, unaware that Xiao Jue is following close behind. Inside, she disguises herself as a dancer and ends up on stage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sun Chuanfu tries to get news about the prime minister from Chu Zhao. Xiao Jue visits the Sun residence to ask about the military funds and rations.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Yingxiang reports her findings to Chu Zhao, who tells her to continue trailing Xiao Jue. Meanwhile, Ding Yi doubts He Yan is truly blind and tests her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: He Yan sets out to seek justice for the murdered women, only to find the commander has already launched a secret investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As He Yan analyzes the Sun Xiangfu case, she suspects He Rufei is tied to the Battle of Mingshui. Later, her squad drags her to the hot springs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: He Yan suspects Hu Yuanzhong is a foreign spy but can't confirm it. After a masked assassin attacks, she finds Ma Damei dead and becomes the main suspect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Shen Han arrives, guilt-ridden, and apologizes, revealing that He Yan gave him the defense map, which raises the commander's suspicions again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: He Yan buys Xiao Jue a new zither to replace the one she broke. Chu Zhao visits the camp and invites He Yan for drinks, making Xiao Jue jealous.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: To chase a lead, Xiao Jue heads to Jiyang under a fake identity and asks He Yan to pose as his wife. Will real romance blossom from this act?

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: As Xu Jingfu reveals the secret tunnel to the Uto, Cheng Lisu takes Xiao Jue's group shopping, where Miss Yan vies with He Yan for the commander's favor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Everyone searches for Chai Anxi, who barely escapes. At the Water God Festival, He Yan eyes a grand prize and coaxes Xiao Jue to win it for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: After spending the night together on a houseboat, He Yan and Xiao Jue spot signs of Uto activity. They follow a trail and witness a kidnapping.

Entries.Title: Filter
Entries.Description: Su Chengcheng attended the interview at the Marketing Department of Vandai Cosmetics Company, but was directly eliminated by the interviewer because of her appearance.

Episodes.Title: Magic Bracelet
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng attended the interview at the Marketing Department of Vandai Cosmetics Company, but was directly eliminated by the interviewer because of her appearance.

Episodes.Title: New Idea
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng walked home and met her parents. Su Chengcheng called out to her parents, but they didn't recognize her at all.

Episodes.Title: Lies
Episodes.Description: In order to dispel Tang Qi's entanglement with Su Miao, Su Chengcheng, who turned into Su Miao, deliberately made a fool of herself at the dinner table to annoy Tang Qi. However, Tang Qi became more appreciative of Su Miao because of her bravery to show her true self in front of others.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Night
Episodes.Description: After the company dinner, Lin Yuan drove to pick up Su Chengcheng, but Gu Yu got into the car first. Su Chengcheng had no choice but to send the drunk Tang Qi home.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi learned from Gu Yu that Su Miao was at Lin Yuan's house. So he went to Lin's house to invite Su Miao to dinner dating, hoping to formally confess his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Crisis of Exposing True Identity
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi came to the hospital to visit Su Miao, but the Filter was upgrading. As the truth was about to be exposed, Su Chengcheng tried to escape.

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Plan
Episodes.Description: Su Miao invited Tang Qi to meet by the lake. Tang Qi came, but he didn't know that Su Chengcheng's perfect plan is waiting for him.

Episodes.Title: His Secret
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng transformed into Su Miao's alpaca and entered Tang Qi's house. Tang Qi spoke with Alpaca from the bottom of his heart, allowing Su Chengcheng to know Tang Qi's secret.

Episodes.Title: Relationship Improved
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng wanted to compensate Tang Qi in her own way. However, Tang Qi was disappointed with Su Chengcheng as a subordinate, so he was indifferent to her kindness.

Episodes.Title: Having Feelings For Her Again
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng used Fang Jin's name to ask Tang Qi for a meeting. In the cafe, Tang Qi watched 'Fang Jin' interacting with the waiter and was moved by her cuteness and friendly attitude.

Episodes.Title: Uncontrollable Now Playing Attraction
Episodes.Description: Guan Shengyu wanted to sell the patent to another company. Tang Qi tried to avoid 'Fang Jin', but he had to discuss countermeasures with her. 'Fang Jin' proposed a wise plan, and this made Tang Qi uncontrollably attracted by her.

Episodes.Title: Misunderstanding
Episodes.Description: In order to get rid of Guan Shengyu, Su Chengcheng lied that she was dating Tang Qi. Guan Shengyu was not convinced and said it is impossible for Tang Qi to love a woman with such unattractive appearance. Unexpectedly, Tang Qi hugged Su Chengcheng and praised her for her beauty. Su Chengcheng was shocked.

Episodes.Title: Strange Feelings
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi went to the laboratory to find Fang Jin. At this time, Su Chengcheng, who was stuck in the image of 'Fang Jin', was studying the new products with the real Fang Jin in the laboratory.

Episodes.Title: Two 'Fang Jin'
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng transformed into 'Fang Jin', and Tang Qi confessed to her. 'Fang Jin' fled in panic. Tang Qi met the real Fang Jin and asked for her reply. From the reaction of the real Fang Jin, Tang Qi finally confirmed there were two 'Fang Jin'.

Episodes.Title: Her New Boyfriend
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi kept sending messages to 'Fang Jin', trying to find out the truth. Su Chengcheng came up with a plan to make Tang Qi give up.

Episodes.Title: The Only One Shining With Colours
Episodes.Description: After 'Fang Jin' disappeared, Tang Qi suddenly lost colour vision, and was unable to recognize traffic lights. Strangely, he found that he could only see colours on Su Chengcheng.

Episodes.Title: Retrieving Colours
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi decided to tell Su Chengcheng about his eyes, hoping to ask for her help to find out the reason for his loss of colour vsion.

Episodes.Title: A Familiar Stranger
Episodes.Description: Gu Yu suggested Quan Shengtang to attend the Qixi Festival event as the model of Lin Yuan's comics. Su Chengcheng and Lin Yuan checked into the inn reserved by the company and found that Quan Shengtang had to share the room with Tang Qi.

Episodes.Title: Close Contact
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi told Su Chengcheng that he could regain colours when he had close contact with her. Su Chengcheng kissed Tang Qi, and successfully restored his eyes to normal.

Episodes.Title: Hallucination
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi and Quan Shengtang drove back to the city. In the thunderstorm, the Filter flickered, Su Chengcheng changed her face in front of Tang Qi.

Episodes.Title: Verifying His Guess
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi discovered that the bloodstains of Quan Shengtang on his cuffs were fake. He went to the police station to look for Quan Shengtang's information, but found that there was no such person. Tang Qi already had the answer in his mind.

Episodes.Title: A Flawless Trap
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi set up a trap for Su Chengcheng at his home, waiting for her to come and expose the truth.

Episodes.Title: Uncover the Truth
Episodes.Description:
Tang Qi told the truth - Su Miao, Fang Jin and Quan Shengtang are actually fabricated by Su Chengcheng! Su Chengcheng sincerely apologized and

explained how she had been deceiving him using various identities.

Episodes.Title: Confession Rejected
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi confessed to Su Chengcheng, but Su Chengcheng thought he was teasing her and said she only wanted to maintain an ordinary colleague relationship with him.

Episodes.Title: Safe Haven
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi confessed again, and Chengcheng finally accepted his love.

Episodes.Title: Secret Love
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng didn't want to make their relationship public in office. Tang Qi was unhappy with her attitude.

Episodes.Title: Malfunction
Episodes.Description: The Filter started to malfunction and change Su Chengcheng's appearance randomly. Su Chengcheng's parents asked her to take Tang Qi home for dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Old
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi and Su Chengcheng investigated the old lady who gave Su Chengcheng the Filter. Eventually, they found that she had passed away long ago.

Episodes.Title: Invisible Human
Episodes.Description: Su Chengcheng told her parents the truth about the Filter Bracelet, and she began to live as an invisible human.

Episodes.Title: Keeping Lin Yuan's Secret
Episodes.Description: Lin Yuan was pregnant but she want to tell Gu Yu. She asked Chengcheng to keep it secret.

Episodes.Title: Telling the Truth
Episodes.Description: Su Qingli misunderstood that Su Chengcheng was pregnant. The Su family gathered and demanded Tang Qi and Su Chengcheng to get married immediately.

Episodes.Title: Propose to Her Again
Episodes.Description: Tang Qi felt regret that Su Chengcheng was invisible when he proposed to her. So he prepared a ring and planned to propose again.
